fields.essence: This is the energy of creation itself, the force that begins everything and is always beginning again. In you it makes what was not there before, in a shape no one else could have made. When it is moving you are more alive than at any other time. The work has light in it, something in you has to come out, and bringing it out is a joy. It arrives in its own time and leaves the same way.
fields.glance:
This is the energy of creation itself, the force that begins everything and is always beginning again. In you it makes what was not there before, in a shape no one else could have made. When it is moving you are more alive than at any other time. The work has light in it, something in you has to come out, and bringing it out is a joy. It arrives in its own time and leaves the same way.

In balance, this power has no fear of mistakes. Nothing new has ever been made without hundreds of wrong turns, so you begin before you know how it will end. What you are making will move one way and then another as it comes into the world. Let it, because it has a life of its own. Your part is to be there when it happens, with a light hand, the way a midwife is there for a birth. By the time it is finished it has made you as much as you made it, and that is where the beauty is.

There are stretches when nothing comes, and they belong to this power as much as the making does. What comes next is being made in you where you cannot see it, and it needs you quiet, mostly on your own. Asking what is wrong with you is the one thing that makes the quiet last. Let it be, rest, and it comes back the way it left. It returns all at once, carrying what it made in the dark.
fields.iching:
Something is starting, and the whole of its life is still ahead of it. Everything that begins passes through four seasons. It springs up, it grows and it is gathered in, then it is tried for what it is worth. What you are asking about belongs to the whole cycle, not to this part, so look at all four from here. Nothing is yours until it has come through the last, and that takes longer than any beginning expects.

Keep going, but never by force. The sky moves through the day and the night without straining, which is why it never wears out. Make yourself strong the same way, a little every day rather than all of it in one blaze. Keep the pace of what is unfolding, slow when it is slow and fast when it is fast. Before you set out, be sure who you are and where you came from. A force this size carries you a long way in whichever direction you are facing. The one danger in it is going too far. A strength like this can burn what it has made before it has taken shape.

A beginning is felt first in the head, high behind the eyes, long before the hands get any of it. Hold yourself the way the sky moves, steady and unhurried, with nothing in it strained. Heaven over Heaven is the hexagram of a beginning. Heaven is the strength in you that starts something and keeps it going without tiring. Here it is above and below, and nothing in you holds it back. Strength on strength carries a beginning to its end, one stage at a time. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a dragon, asleep under deep water in winter and rising into the sky in spring. A plan you carry rises the same way, from unseen to seen to as high as it can go. Whatever you begin has a time to lie low and a time to rise. The Creative
fields.gene_keys:
Entropy Freshness Beauty Met, this energy is a fire, and what you bring out is alive the way a flame is alive. One morning the colour is back in things, and the joy has come with no more warning than sadness ever gave. With it comes something that has to be said or made, in your voice or with your hands. You take the step nobody has taken. Even when it fails you are out of the place you were shut in, which was the point.

Where it does most is a small room: a family, a few people who work together. Give it its moment and the whole room wakes. Then leave sooner than seems polite, because fresh things do not keep. The one who lit the room can drain it by staying too long. The ones who carry this well are soft rather than hard, plain rather than shiny. A fire is delicate and burns whoever grabs at it. Your strength is being able to be alone, trusting your own timing over anyone's. This energy goes flat some days, and the days go flat with it. You reach the end of one tired and cannot say what it was for. The word for it is numbness. Numbness is a feeling, though almost nobody knows they are in it, and knowing is most of the way out. You will do nearly anything rather than feel it, reach for the phone or call someone, and each works for about a minute.

Put a hand on your chest and notice what is there, even if it is nothing. Nothing is what it is meant to feel like at first, so let it stay, with no pressure on it to change. It is not comfortable, nor is it meant to be. It is a gap, and a life needs its gaps. A bored child is not asking for a list of things to do, only for the blank to be seen, and you are the same. A fire begins as kindling that looks like nothing, then a breath on it. The flat you feel is the kindling, and your noticing it is the breath. Everything you look at is beautiful. A face or a grey week in winter shines with being exactly what it is, and the light is the same in all of it. It is so delicate that one word cracks it. A student once sat a whole dawn on a mountain beside his teacher. When the sun rose he said one word, beautiful. The teacher afterwards called him a noisy fellow. The moment you say a thing is beautiful you have stepped outside it, so you say less and see more.

It is the fire when there is no longer anyone it is happening to. Even the flat days are beautiful from here, because they were part of it. All you can do is live it where people can see. Some will resent you for it, and some will come to stand in the light.
fields.human_design:
Self-Expression The pressure in you to make things your own way comes from Gate 1. It is the drive to show what is inside you, in your shape and no one else's. Nobody taught you the style. It is the one you had as a child, before anyone told you how things are done. When there is nowhere for it to go you are miserable, without always knowing why. When it does get out, the people near you feel more like themselves for having seen it.

From outside, doing it your way every time can look like stubbornness. What is going on is simpler. The making and the self are one movement, so asking you to do it the usual way is asking you to be someone else. The cost is that you are misunderstood more than most, and a hard word about the work lands like a hard word about you. In time you learn that being different was the strength all along. Trying to be original on purpose is the one thing that chokes it.
fields.tarot: The making has gone well for once, and now there is more than you know what to do with. Ancestors Bloom holds that moment: a loaded cart, and plenty that keeps only while it is going somewhere. You belong with it, and what the family holds is one thing. What you were given cannot be kept, only spent. Here it is spent on the making, there on the handing out. Open it when something is in your hands and you want to know what it was for. One face from the Tarot stands near this strength, brought by its family.
fields.body:
Spring is the reason this energy is given to the liver. The liver is the organ of spring. It is the first to wake in the year, it starts the growing, it keeps the life in you moving through the whole of you. When the liver is at ease, everything in you moves. When it is tight, everything waits. It is also the part of you that plans ahead, the general of the body, choosing which way the season will go. That is the work of the creative force too. It begins the season and sets the direction. The liver is where the body does the same.

Of everything inside you, the liver alone can make itself again. Lose most of it to injury or surgery and within months it has grown back to full size, working the whole time. The energy that begins things was given to the one organ that can begin itself again. It sits under your ribs on the right side, about the size of a small loaf. Rest your hand there and you are resting it on the part of you that starts over. The spark you were born with has a substance in you, and the substance is lysine. You cannot make it. Your body takes it in, from meat or beans, or goes without. It is the same with the fire in you. On a morning when yours has dropped to a flicker, nobody notices you, and nothing you do by force brings it back. What brings it back in you is being fed, from outside and in its own time.

While it burns, everyone wants to be near you, and what you have then is a fire with something to feed. That is the same fire a season on, gathering a harvest round it, and in your body the two are made of one thing. Push it up by will and you pay, in what you give up to keep it lit. Fed, it comes back to you on its own.

fields.essence: Trust lets life reach you all the way, even what you would not have chosen. You feel it in the middle of your chest. You carry what you are given while it grows, at its own pace. Chance meetings and small openings find you when you are not looking.
fields.glance:
Trust lets life reach you all the way, even what you would not have chosen. You feel it in the middle of your chest. You carry what you are given while it grows, at its own pace. Chance meetings and small openings find you when you are not looking.

Some days you feel out of place, and you take everything on alone. You have never lost your way, even when it feels that way. Let the feeling sink in instead of filling the day with more to do. Then ask for the help you need.

Clear a way for what you need, and it comes to you. Step beyond the hard shell you hold around yourself, and more life moves through you. When a friend is struggling, stay beside them instead of giving advice. Let them see your weak places as well as your strong ones. Your trust is catching, and the people around you begin to relax.
fields.iching:
You have been given something to carry through, and that is the whole of the work now. You did not start it, and it is not yours to steer. What it asks is the strength of the mare. She runs as far as any horse and still runs behind, going where the ground goes. Set out in front and you lose the way at once. Come behind, and the one worth following shows.

Keep to your own kind while this lasts, the ones who grow things and wait for them. You will lose the ones who charge ahead, and losing them is part of it. The ground lies soft until it moves, and then nothing is firmer. That is how you can be, and it goes well when you rest in what is steady.

Your belly carries weight all day, and nobody has to tell it how. It is the soft front of you, and it goes tight before you notice. Let it go, sit the way the ground sits, and hold what came to you until it is done. Earth over Earth is the hexagram of taking in what life brings. Earth is the part of you that receives whatever comes and bears its weight. Here it meets more of itself underneath. Inside and out you are the same, so there is no gap between what you are and what you show. That is why this hexagram has long been read as the ground under everything. The ground under your house carries its weight every hour, and nobody has to ask it to. Where nothing in you resists, what comes to you can grow into all it is going to be. The Receptive
fields.gene_keys:
Dislocation Orientation Unity You find your way here by being carried, not by steering. The ground moves and you go with it. Things line up without your arranging them. The person you needed turns up, or you find you are in the right town with no plan behind it. None of it can be forced, because it happens while you are looking elsewhere. Your timing sharpens until being out of step shows up in your body as plainly as hunger. You start to look like yourself.

What it does for other people is the strange part. To set someone on their way you give them no advice, because advice they can get anywhere. You sit with them and want nothing from them. You let them see your weakness as much as your strength, and in your company they find out that being afraid is safe. You did not have to do anything. Harmony is catching, and a person who has stopped fighting their own life steadies the room. Somewhere along the way you stepped off the world, and you cannot say where. You stand on the same ground as everyone else, and it does not seem to hold you. You have been out of place in every room since. Most often it shows as busyness. The days fill, the load goes onto your shoulders, and your hands keep moving so you cannot hear the hollow underneath. The usual move is to change the outside with a new plan or a new town. The relief lasts as long as the unpacking.

No turn you took was wrong. The feeling is real. What it tells you about your life is not true. It changes when you stop outrunning it and let it soak in, the way rain soaks into a field. What you were running from is a longing for home, and that longing is the first sign of the road back. You are home, and you know it. You stop looking, because there is no distance to cross. There is the ground and there is you, with no line where one ends and the other starts. Stand next to someone and there are three of you, counting the pair you make. Being home is ordinary, the plainest thing you know, and it holds everything.

Life goes on moving, and you are the ground it moves over, the way the seasons move over a field. Nothing is leading you now. You leave every mystery exactly where it is. You are back in the middle of your own life, which is where you have been all along.
fields.human_design:
Direction of the Self You feel where your life is heading before you have chosen it. Gate 2 is the name for that pull, and it sits in the middle of your chest. It does not make the road. It feels where the road already goes, and what belongs on that road comes toward you. A field knows which way is downhill without measuring anything, and you know your direction like that. If someone asks why you are going this way, you can only say that it is the way.

To anyone watching, this can look like waiting. Nobody sees a direction arriving, so they see you not deciding and call it drift. The cost sits somewhere else. You take it all on alone and settle for less than you wanted, because you did not trust that help would come. Let the direction find you, and let the help in with it.
fields.tarot: This ground follows whoever walks on it, and far enough along you stop knowing whose journey it is. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of Water, and the other is Odyssey of Freedom. There you stop copying the lives around you and show what you are. Water always finds its way to more water. Open it when following has left you wondering who is travelling. Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, stand near this energy and no closer.
fields.body:
Everything in the front of you comes to one bone, the breastbone, which is why this energy belongs there. It is the flat bone down the middle of your chest, about the length of your hand. The collarbones come to its top and the ribs come to its edges from both sides. It goes out to nothing. It holds the front of you together by being the place things arrive. The ground works that way too, starting nothing and carrying what falls into it.

Every breath moves that bone, and the bone moves nothing. Rest two fingers in the notch at its top, between the collarbones, and breathe in. It lifts, then settles. You cannot move it on purpose. The ribs carry it a dozen or so times a minute, and they have done that since your first breath. Your fingers are resting on the part of you that is carried. Trust is not something you decide. Your body makes it slowly and lets it out while you rest. The substance under it is phenylalanine. You cannot make phenylalanine. It arrives in meat, eggs or beans, or not at all. Part of it is built into you as it came. The rest becomes what wakes you and moves you, then the colour of your skin and hair.

When you let something reach you, your body changes before your mind does. That is why you can feel held before you have understood anything. The further life carries you, the more people see who you actually are. Both of those happen on the same substance in you. The more you give way, the more of your own strength you feel.

fields.essence: Something new is alive in you, and this is the energy of its beginning. It has no shape yet, and it is already the most real thing you carry. You can feel how much is there without being able to say what it will become. That is what a beginning is from the inside, fullness and not knowing in one breath. Underneath, where nothing shows, a root is going down, and a root goes down for a long time before anything comes up.
fields.glance:
Something new is alive in you, and this is the energy of its beginning. It has no shape yet, and it is already the most real thing you carry. You can feel how much is there without being able to say what it will become. That is what a beginning is from the inside, fullness and not knowing in one breath. Underneath, where nothing shows, a root is going down, and a root goes down for a long time before anything comes up.

Carried well, this energy knows what the wrong turns are for. Everything that has ever grown began by pushing against something harder than itself, and the pushing is where its strength comes from. So the missteps at the start are not the cost of the thing but the making of it. What you have to push with is the store you began with, and it is enough, because everything this will become is already folded inside it. Keep the moves small and let them be rough. A small move made now holds.

The hard part is the pull to hurry. Not knowing what this will become is uncomfortable, and the discomfort asks you to settle it early, to name it or plan it to the end so the not knowing can stop. Settle it now and you settle it small. The store you began with is for one morning, the morning the ground gives, and a seed does not spend it early on the way there. Stay with the small moves, and when the ground gives it will not be little by little.
fields.iching:
You have started something in a hard place, and the difficulty you feel is the difficulty of every start. The push is from below, the shock that woke the thing; the weight is above, a storm that has built and not broken. Between the two, what you have begun is trying to get its head above the ground, and the ground is hard.

What it asks of you is not to set out for the goal yet. Nothing large should be undertaken from here. Gather the loose strands of what you have, sort them, and twist them into one cord you can hold, because the disorder is only strands that have not been laid together. Then find the people who can carry part of it and give them real charge, since a beginning that is one person's alone stays small. Keep near you someone who knows this ground, and do nothing by force.

In the body the shock is the foot, the part of you that steps first. The deep water is the ear, which hears the rain coming before the eye sees it. Notice which of the two you are living in now. The posture for this hour is a horse saddled and standing still: ready in every muscle, going nowhere yet. Keep your strength in, and let it thicken until the rain comes. Water over Thunder: the storm gathered above, and under it the shock that starts things. Clouds and thunder fill the sky, with the rain not yet fallen. The traditional character draws a sprout pressing up through hard ground, with the root drawn far longer than the shoot: what shows is the least of it, and what holds it is below. Difficulty at the Beginning
fields.gene_keys:
Chaos Innovation Innocence Something new comes out of what is changing, and making it is the best feeling you know. Cut a bush down in a garden and within days something else is growing in the space; that is this energy in you. You can work while the ground moves. You try a thing. Most of the tries fail, and the failing is how the shape is found. A child at play repeats one thing, a little differently each time, until something nobody planned appears, and you are doing what the child does. Mistakes are only changes with a judgement on them.

The hands that were holding are open now, so what is around you gets in and changes you. Other people's hands end up in the work, and it is better for them. What the trying needs is one fixed thing to turn around: keep the best version of what you are making in view and give the energy to that, because this much making with nothing to serve runs wild. You do not need to know the way there. You can love the work now without needing it to stay. The fear in this energy is that what you lean on will not stay. The people you love, the work you do: each is a hand holding something still, and somewhere you know that none of it can be made to stay. So the hands close. What you are afraid of is called chaos, and it is not the storm you picture. It is quieter than that, an unease under ordinary days, a low hum you stopped hearing years ago. A threat to one of the things you hold does not make the chaos. It shows you it was there. The usual move is to change something outside, to find a new thing to hold before the old one gives. That works for about as long as it takes to notice you are holding again.

The fear lives low in the belly as a tremor, and it asks only to be felt. Stay with it and it does not get worse; it opens. What you took for the ground going was something starting. Under the fear, the whole time, was love, and the clinging was only love that had not gone all the way. Innocence is what is left when you have lost what you held, more than once, and are still delighted by what arrives. The hands are open because there is nothing left to protect. A newborn has it without knowing; a very old person has it again, after a long search with a good deal of pain in it. The two are the same thing, and the only difference is that the old one knows. Nobody is in control. The child in you has always wanted to find out what happens then.

From here life is a play. You know how it ends, nobody knows the road, and the road is the play. You can grieve on the outside while underneath you watch the play go on, and the grief is part of it. Home was never in the body or anywhere in the sky. It is the feeling of love itself, and you are in it.
fields.human_design:
Ordering Giving a new thing a shape that will hold is the pressure this lens sees in the energy of beginning. Gate 3 is where it enters: the drive that takes what has never existed and finds the form it can live in, without which nothing new would ever settle into the world. In you it runs as an urge to get the raw thing into some order the moment it arrives. You try a shape, then another, and keep going until one holds. Where others see a mess you can see the structure that is trying to come through, and that is the strength. It is also why the process cannot be made to run straight.

From outside, the trying looks like disorder, and you may be called someone who starts things without finishing them. What is happening is that a new thing takes time to take root, the way a child takes years before it can be productive, and the waiting is where the doubt gets in. People who carry this all their lives learn to let the tries be tries, and that the panic to bring it out before its time is what burns them.
fields.tarot: Something ended to make room for what you are starting, and you feel the cost before you feel the room. You belong to a family of six. Between them they hold one whole life, and yours is the first breath. The others hold the watching and the cutting away, then the turn at the bottom, the feeding and the finishing. What the six share is one trust: whatever is let go finds its next shape. Open the one whose season you are in, to see that trust further along. Five faces gather here, one from the family and four from the weather.
fields.body:
The place in the body for this energy is the navel, and the reason is birth. The navel is the mark of the first beginning you ever made. For nine months you were fed there by a supply you did not make. In your first minutes outside, the cord was cut and the vessels closed on their own. From then on you did for yourself what had been done for you. What the vessels became still ties your wall at that point, one cord running up to your liver, two running down. Everything you have begun since was begun the same way, on a store you were given, before you could do it for yourself.

Press a finger straight into the navel and you meet something firm at once, the scar that closed it. Press a finger's width to either side and the wall gives. There is no muscle under your finger there, only the sheets from the two sides meeting, with the scar in their one gap. You are pressing on the place where you first had to begin. The beginning in you has a chemistry, one substance it shares with its kin, and the substance is leucine. You cannot make it; your body takes it in, from meat or beans, or goes without. There is more of it in you than of any other piece you are built from, about one in every ten, so it is in everything you are made of, the hands as much as the heart.

Everything alive in you is changing, and what you are becoming takes with it what you have just left. In the body that is a fact about substance: what you will be is built of the same stuff as what you were, taken in from outside. The change never stops while you are alive, and the day it stops is the day you are not. While this energy is in you, the change is what you feel.

fields.essence: Understanding comes to you when you are new to something and its meaning is still under a veil. You understand people, even the ones who see a thing the opposite way to you. Loose pieces of what you learn fit together in you, and you can say the whole simply. You feel it in your whole body, as a knowing in your belly before your mind can explain it.
fields.glance:
Understanding comes to you when you are new to something and its meaning is still under a veil. You understand people, even the ones who see a thing the opposite way to you. Loose pieces of what you learn fit together in you, and you can say the whole simply. You feel it in your whole body, as a knowing in your belly before your mind can explain it.

Some days your mind will not stop asking, and every answer it finds only opens another question. It may try to run your life, though it cannot tell you where to live or whom to love. Then say plainly that you are new to this. Stop, take a breath, and come back to one thing.

Let your mind look into things, talk them over and play with how they fit. Make your mistakes freely, since being new is what they are for. Live your questions fully, and understanding rises in you on its own, clear enough to share with anyone who asks.
fields.iching:
Something is in front of you that you do not understand, and you are the one who has to learn it. What you will become is still hidden, the way a seedling is hidden under the soil. You are ready to learn and do not yet know what you need.

This asks one thing of you: go and ask. Find the one who knows this ground, ask them once, and mean it. The first answer is the clear one. Ask the same thing a second time, then a third, and you have stopped asking. You are stirring the water, and every stir clouds it until nothing can be read there. Take the answer you were given and carry it off without another word. Then do the plain work well while the answer settles in you. A character grows out of small things finished.

Your hand and your ear are the two parts to use now. A hand holds a thing steady so you can look at it. An ear takes in what you cannot see. Hold still and listen. There is real danger under you here, the danger of not knowing, so stop at its edge and do not go down there alone. Mountain over Water is the hexagram of being new to something. Water is the danger in you of not knowing what you are doing. Mountain is the stillness that stops you there. The stillness sits above the danger because when you cannot see the way, stopping is what keeps you safe. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a spring at the foot of a mountain. A spring runs clearest where it leaves the ground and picks up dirt the further it goes. So what you learn right at the start of something matters most. Stop where you cannot see ahead, and you can be taught. Youthful Folly
fields.gene_keys:
Intolerance Understanding Forgiveness Understanding is what the water does once you stop stirring it: it clears by itself. It has nothing to do with knowledge. Knowledge is what your mind reaches for to take the unease away. The most it can hand you is the hope of peace, and that hope is what keeps you asking. Understanding arrives after you have looked at a thing from every side and found that each side can be argued. A riddle with no answer works the same way on a mind: the moment it sees its logic will never solve the thing, something gives. The answer comes up as a feeling in the whole of you, from the belly, and the question is done with.

Freed from the question, your mind goes back to what it loves, which is looking at patterns and playing with them. You see both sides of an argument and take neither. You understand people the same way. The restlessness is still in you, pointed outward now, at what could be put right in the world. Intolerance is a slant in your own logic. You have a bad day, decide you do not like someone, and by evening you have a list of good reasons. Underneath the reasons is a feeling, and the logic only measures what you sent it to find. That is how an opinion hardens into a certainty and a resentment into a conviction. You go blind with your own reasoning and cannot see that you have. Blame comes out of the reasons, then guilt, then a world split into sides.

Most people cannot sit alone in a room for an hour with nothing to do. They cannot bear their own minds. Under all of that is fear, thrown onto other people and held in place by an argument. Look honestly at the other side of your own opinion and you will find the fear it stands on. You handed your mind a job it cannot do, which is to make you safe. Forgiveness is a warmth that goes straight through the border between two people and finds no debt on either side. None of what happened was personal. The part of your mind that needed a reason for it has died. What takes its place watches the old story and does not pick it up. No restlessness is left in you. You cannot make forgiveness happen. It comes when you are tired enough of the drama, and it lands like a surprise. Something choked in your chest comes open. Then the forgiveness runs backward down the line of the people you came from, untying what they left tied. Debts that stood for generations are cancelled at their source. Water that nobody stirs runs clear, and anyone downstream can drink.
fields.human_design:
Formulization You are under a pressure to make sense of things, and Gate 4 is the name for it. It takes a pile of loose facts and finds the shape they make. It will not rest until something fits. You puzzle at everything and have to know how a thing works before you can leave it alone. You are happiest when a pattern closes. What it makes is an answer, and that is how the mind tries to make your life safe. Every answer is a guess that fitted. Hold it as a possibility and you can drop it the moment a better one comes. A mind that can drop its answers stays light.

A mind like this gets called a know-it-all, the one with an answer for everything. You can be wrong and sound completely sure at the same time. The pull is to act on an idea the moment it arrives, before it has taken root. Then you doubt yourself when it does not take. The idea was not wrong; it was early. Watch which of your answers the world goes on to prove, and let the rest go.
fields.tarot: Wanting a reason is what this energy does inside a bond, and it has to learn to live without one. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Union, and all four are about how you manage to be with other people. UL 7, Essential Nexus, is the guidance you follow in a group. UL 29, All In, is the yes you give with the whole of you. UL 59, Mystics Treasures, is the closeness that gets through your guard. This one carries the reasons people give each other. Five of the tarot's major cards stand around this energy, and most of them show you a way to learn.
fields.body:
The neocortex is where this energy sits in you, and the reason is youth. It is the thin folded sheet over the outside of your brain, the newest part of it in the history of animals. It is also the last part of you to finish. The front of it, where you weigh things up, is still being wired into your middle twenties. It takes in everything it knows from outside you. Your words come from there, and so does every reason you have ever given for anything. That is the young mind's work in you. It asks, it takes in, it holds what it was handed.

What this layer has learned, it cannot put down. Look at any word on this page and you cannot see it as marks. The meaning arrives before you can stop it, in a fraction of a second, doing what took you years to learn. Now try to un-read it. That is a first answer gone into you, and there is no asking it back out. The mind that cannot leave a question alone has a substance in you, and its name is valine. You cannot make it. Your body takes it in, from milk or meat, or goes without. When your body builds a protein it folds valine into the middle, away from water. The same substance carries a change this energy is making, from asking to understanding. A child born with that change already has a mind that does not run riot, from the first day.

The reasons you give for not being able to bear someone are made of that same substance. So is the closeness that gets past a guard. So is the yes you give with the whole of you. It is one chemistry for how people manage to be together. Without this energy there would be no reasons between you and anyone, no expectations and no blame.

fields.essence: Patience is alive in you as trust in the timing of your life, and you feel it low in your belly. Your breath runs deep and slow, and your day keeps its own beat of meals, sleep and work. You can sit in the space between one thing and the next and feel at home there. People near you calm down, and the work around you goes more smoothly.
fields.glance:
Patience is alive in you as trust in the timing of your life, and you feel it low in your belly. Your breath runs deep and slow, and your day keeps its own beat of meals, sleep and work. You can sit in the space between one thing and the next and feel at home there. People near you calm down, and the work around you goes more smoothly.

At times what you need has not come, and your breath goes shallow as if it never will. Let the urge to push pass without acting on it. Eat well and rest while you wait, because resting is not giving up. A hard season changes on its own, the way spring follows winter.

Each time you wait this way, waiting comes easier, until it feels like rest. Your heart opens, and you grow gentle with everyone who comes your way. When the time comes you are strong and ready, and what you waited for finds you.
fields.iching:
You have done your part, and the thing you are waiting on has not moved. There is no weakness in that. What stands in front of you will not be pushed: a river too high to cross today, or a person who has not decided. The timing belongs to the sky, which takes no instructions. You cross the great water at the end of the wait, when the crossing is sure.

What this asks is that you be sure of the thing and stop looking for a sign. You can only wait this long for something true. If the thing you are waiting for is real, it stays clear to you the whole time. Keep to the ones who can wait beside you without talking about it. Sit down to your meals and enjoy them.

Your head and your ear are the parts to use now. The head stays up and clear while the rest of you sits. The ear hears a change before the eye sees it, so stop watching the sky and listen. Stand the way a farmer stands at his door with the seed already in the ground, under a sky that has not broken. Nothing about that is idle. Every small move you make inside the wait comes good. Water over Heaven is the hexagram of waiting for what you need. Heaven is the strength in you that never stops going at a thing. Water is the danger ahead that no strength gets through. The danger sits above the strength because you can go anywhere on strength except through this. That is why this hexagram has long been read as clouds gathered in the sky before the rain. Everything that grows needs the rain, and no one can make it fall. The name has been translated as waiting and as needing, because what you need and cannot have yet is what you wait for. You are strong here, and the timing is not yours. Waiting
fields.gene_keys:
Impatience Patience Timelessness Patience starts as something you do on purpose. You notice the urge to force a thing, you do not act on it, and the unease stays a while. Then the loop that fed it goes quiet. Done often enough it sinks in. One day your body cools on its own, the way a mist comes off a river to calm a hot afternoon. Nothing has changed and everything is easier. From there you hear the rhythms you were moving too fast to notice.

Looking back, you keep finding a pattern that carried you, even through the hardest times. The same slowing makes you kinder. Patience goes first and love comes in behind it. Impatience is a tightness in you that says everything should already have happened. The reply is late. The thing on its way is somehow too slow. It feels like drive and gets used as drive. What you begin from it lands a beat off, because acting out of agitation is never the same as acting out of resolve. Under it is a fear older than anything that happened to you, the fear that nothing is holding the pattern together. A body tuned to that fear never feels safe, whatever you arrange around it. Your breath goes high and shallow. The whole of you braces like someone late. It is a dry afternoon spent watching a sky that will not break, and the watching makes it longer.

None of this is a flaw in you. It is your own rhythm gone missing, and you can find it again. Feel the restlessness instead of obeying it and it sinks on its own. The further you go into the fear under it, the more patient you become. No one is waiting any more. The rain falls or it does not, and nobody in you is keeping count. Patience has gone along with impatience, because both of them need time to happen in. The hours no longer have any hold on you. Moods still come and go. The patterns that make up a person keep running, the way weather runs. You are still in all of it and no longer gripping any of it. This is very ordinary, quieter than the word makes it sound.

It is what patience becomes when even the one being patient lets go: the end of all fighting. Everything alive is waiting, and a life can be read as one long wait for its end. From here that is not sad, only true.
fields.human_design:
Fixed Patterns You need your day to have a shape, and Gate 5 is the name for that need. It wants its meals at their hour and its sleep at its hour. It wants the same small returns every day. Discipline has nothing to do with this. It is older, from where the body keeps itself alive by doing the same things at the same times. In you it runs as comfort in the repeated thing, the walk at its time, the bed made before anything else. When your day keeps its pattern you have more of yourself for everything in it. When the pattern goes you feel it before you can say why.

From outside this gets called rigid, or afraid of anything new. What is really happening is that you are keeping a rhythm, and the rhythm is what lets the rest of your life move freely. It goes wrong from both ends, by forcing order on the day or by giving up on shape altogether. Keep your hours without apologising for them, and stop asking anyone else to keep theirs.
fields.tarot: This waiting keeps a strength ready until its time comes. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light, and each of them holds a strength that is not spent at once. UL 9, Ease in This, is where you spend it one small step at a time. UL 11, Sol Star, is where you turn it into a picture of how things could be. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is where you let it build the longer you hold it in. Five of the tarot's major cards sit around this energy, and each shows one side of waiting well.
fields.body:
The sacral plexus is where this energy sits in you. The reason is that this is the part of you that can hold something until it is time. It is a weave of nerves against the inner face of the flat bone at the base of your spine. Out of it run the nerves of your legs and of your bladder and bowel. Both of them fill on a schedule you did not set. This weave carries up the news that one is full, then holds it closed until the hour suits you. The engine that works you all day lives here too. It runs down by night, fills while you sleep, and is whole before you ask.

You are doing it now. Your bladder has been filling since you last stood up, and this weave is holding it until the hour comes. Put a hand flat on the base of your spine, on the bone between your hips. The weave lies just inside there, and your hand is resting on the part of you that can wait. The stillness this energy asks of you has a substance in you, and its name is threonine. Your body cannot make it. It arrives in what you eat, in eggs or beans, or it does not arrive at all. Beyond what it builds, it sets how your cells take light in and turn it into something you can use. How much light reaches you is set by how you live: fear closes it down, an open heart draws it in.

Three other energies in you run on the same substance, and it does the same work in all four. When you are in love the hours pass differently, as though you had stepped out of time. Patience felt deep in your body does the same thing more slowly. It opens your heart, and an open heart lets the light in.

fields.essence: Diplomacy is alive in you as a feel for people, and it starts in your belly. You sense a quarrel coming before anyone has spoken, while there is still time to change your words. You can say a hard truth kindly, at the moment it can be heard. When someone's anger comes at you, you take it in and let it go back no bigger than it came.
fields.glance:
Diplomacy is alive in you as a feel for people, and it starts in your belly. You sense a quarrel coming before anyone has spoken, while there is still time to change your words. You can say a hard truth kindly, at the moment it can be heard. When someone's anger comes at you, you take it in and let it go back no bigger than it came.

At times your guard goes up before you have answered, as if this person could take something from you. Stay in your body and let the feeling run its course without putting it on them. When you watch it instead of obeying it, it moves through and leaves you clear.

Move toward the people who stir you up, with your guard lowered and your heart where they can see it. Look after your own heart, and it comes back to life. What you were guarding against turns out to be a mirage. More people come close, and near you they soften.
fields.iching:
Your case in this dispute is honest, and the other side will not hear it. The two of you are pulling apart, and every push widens the gap. Nobody comes out of the far end of a quarrel with what they wanted. So stop halfway, while you still can. The middle of a dispute is the one place in it where things settle well.

This time asks for a fair third person, someone who wants nothing from either side. Let that person say what is really being fought over. Leave the big ventures alone until this is settled, the move or the new undertaking. Every dispute sits inside a relationship, and you will still live beside this person when it is over. Be firm inside and give way outside, the way water does. Giving way here keeps the peace, and it is no surrender.

Your ears do the work now. Listen until what is said has come all the way in, and only then answer. Heaven over Water is the hexagram of a dispute. Heaven is the drive in you that keeps pressing forward and never tires. Water is the part of you that feels at risk and means every word. The strength sits above the risk because you push hardest when you feel least safe. This hexagram has long been read as the sky rising while water runs down. In an argument each of you keeps talking, and neither one moves toward the other. The harder you press your case, the further you get from the person you want to reach. Conflict
fields.gene_keys:
Conflict Diplomacy Peace Diplomacy begins the moment your guard drops and your heart opens. It has nothing to do with strategy or the right words, which anyone can learn and use with a shut heart. You sense where another person's heart is and how far it is open. You can do this because you let yourself be hurt too, with your heart on your sleeve.

Fear still comes, and you are no longer afraid of it. So other people's fears stop moving you around. The people you are meant to open, and who open you, keep coming into your life. Each one opens you further, and that opens more in them. The guard you keep against other people went up early, between the ages of seven and fourteen. You built it against the heated moments you lived through as a child. Most adults still carry it, and a great deal of a life's strength goes into keeping it up. Behind it your heart hardens, and you judge the other person or simply avoid them.

Think of the hardest relationship in your life now. That person seems able to ruin your peace whenever they like. What you dislike is the part of you they bring out. They are giving you a way into a fear far older than the two of you, carried down from those who came before. Relationships like this hold the start of your own peace, so do not shy away from them. Peace is what is left when there is nothing in you to defend. An old man crossing a river bumped his boat into another, and the man in it cursed him. He did not react at all, since there was not a soul in his boat to shout at. Live like that and nothing reaches you as an attack. This peace lies under everything. It is there when you stop what you are doing and listen, to birds singing or the wind dropping. Even your skin stops being a wall, and you feel life moving in everything that lives. Nobody can take your life from you, because you are life.
fields.human_design: Friction Gate 6 sits in the centre of feeling, low in the body, and presses you toward other people. It carries two things at once: the wish to be close, and the fear of being seen as you are. Closeness is the thing it fears most. When it runs well, your feeling brings people together in a way that is fair to each of them. When it runs badly, you feel that nobody will see you unless you force your way in. Its work is to trust that what you say will reach people at the right time, without pushing.
fields.tarot: This energy breaks down the walls between two people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Alchemy, whose theme is turning something rough into something fine. UL 40, Eternal Wellspring, carries the new openness into a community. UL 47, Garden of Alchemy, carries the change of old ways. UL 64, Communion, carries the fresh possibilities that follow. This one carries the first opening, between two people. Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, to this one.
fields.body:
The belly knows first, and that is why this energy is given to the net of nerves over your gut. Your gut has a nervous system of its own, with more nerve cells than your spinal cord. Most of the news on the great nerve between belly and brain runs upward, so the belly reports before the head decides. Under threat these nerves slow the gut and send blood to the muscles. That is the drop or the knot you feel in an argument before anyone speaks.

Bring to mind someone you have been avoiding, and your belly answers before the thought is finished. Then breathe out slowly with a hand laid flat below your ribs. The nerves that tightened it let it go as the breath lengthens. Your hand rests on the part of you that felt it first. When the last wall in you comes down, your body follows, and every cell in it makes peace with the rest. That peace has a substance in you, and its name is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from, and it tastes sweet on your tongue. Your body makes some, and food adds more, from meat or the bones a soup is boiled on. The same substance that is in you has been found in the dust of a comet.

This energy shares that substance with three of its kin. Together they turn something dark in you into something lighter. It happens in the body first, in the belly, where the rough material is heated until it changes. Then it spreads from one opening to the next, out into the people around you.

fields.essence: Guidance is alive in you as a way of listening. With you at its centre, a group finds its own way and starts to move as one. Someone talks to you and hears their own answer before you have said a word. You sense where things are heading before others do. You are content to steer from behind while someone else takes the front.
fields.glance:
Guidance is alive in you as a way of listening. With you at its centre, a group finds its own way and starts to move as one. Someone talks to you and hears their own answer before you have said a word. You sense where things are heading before others do. You are content to steer from behind while someone else takes the front.

At times you want to be seen for it, and advice comes out before anyone has asked. Wait to be asked, then take your time with the answer. Some days the best help is to hold back, and that takes strength. Hold your own ground, so a charming voice cannot pull you into its plans.

Set your opinions aside and take people in as they are. Near you they grow stronger, and they need you less. Do the good thing for its own sake, with no one watching. Each one adds to the last, out of sight, like water gathering under the ground. In time it shows, and people come to you as they come to a spring.
fields.iching:
A quarrel has gone past words, and people are rising on every side. Strength is being gathered, and it can do great harm. Use it only for a right end, to protect people or to stop someone who is hurting them. The way you use it has to be right as well, above all at the start.

What this time asks for is a seasoned hand. It takes years to know when to press on and when to fall back. Grow your following by being generous to the people. Treat them well, and they will stand with you when it matters.

Your belly and your ears do the work now. The belly carries the weight of everyone who relies on you. The ears hear trouble while it is still far off. Sit the way ground sits over water, still above and holding what lies below. Earth over Water is the hexagram of many people moving as one. Water is the strength in you that can run wild. Earth is the part of you that serves the people around you. The earth sits above because strength does harm until the people it serves take hold of it. This hexagram has long been read as water in the middle of the earth. Your strength works like water in the ground, feeding the fields above it. Its name has been read as a crowd and as the teacher it follows, because the one at the centre shapes where everyone goes. You are strongest among the people you serve. The Army
fields.gene_keys:
Division Guidance Virtue Guidance is help that does not impose, the way good teaching never does. It helps a person find their own way forward and leaves their power with them. A group thrives only when the people in it have power of their own.

Carried like this, you lead from behind the throne rather than on it. You shape the way a group is going without telling the people in it what to do. You make room for them to find their own order, then step back and let someone else have the light. People feel clearer about their own direction just from being near you. What holds it together is trusting life to go where it is going, rather than taking hold of it. Division is the line that puts some people above others, and it runs so deep that it looks like the shape of the world. It sorts everyone into classes and sides, then teaches each side to think that way. After that nobody can picture another arrangement. Some are raised to follow and hand their authority to whoever sounds certain. Others are raised to take that authority and hold on to it. The fear of losing power keeps both in place. Like draws like here. Stand at the level of someone waiting to be rescued, and you draw the leader who profits from keeping you there. Most of the people paid to help would be out of work if you stopped needing them. Without a steady sense of yourself, you can be swept into anyone's plan that sounds exciting enough.

There is nothing wrong with looking up to someone. It is a natural stage. The trick is to find someone who feels what you carry so fully that you dare to feel it yourself. Once you have felt what you carry, it loosens its hold. Virtue is what is best in a person, out in the open air, with nothing in them bent. It has nothing to do with being good on purpose, which anyone can perform. It is your own nature going through you unimpeded. Its reward is itself, past being seen and past being useful. It is delicate, and it cannot breathe where people speak ill of each other. Every day people do small unseen acts of it, and those acts hold the chaos off. An old story says the world is made of the shards of a vessel that broke, and each act sets one shard back. A child raised among people like this needs no other teaching.
fields.human_design:
Collaboration Gate 7 is the pull to give a group one direction. You see how each person fits and what they are good at, so everyone's effort goes the same way. Your place is beside the one at the front, the way a chief of staff directs the energy and holds the team together. A leader is only as strong as the support behind them.

Seen from outside, this can look like control, or like someone who will not take a suggestion. The cost runs inward. Pushed into the spotlight, this pull drains you, because standing at the front is not what it is for.
fields.tarot: This energy leads people. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Union, which holds what people are to one another. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the wish to make sense of things. UL 29, All In, carries the whole yes. UL 59, Mystics Treasures, carries the longing to be known. This one carries the order that lets a group move as one. Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.
fields.body:
The diaphragm is where this energy lives, and the reason is the breath. It is a dome of muscle across your middle, and every breath you take begins there. It tightens and drops, and the whole of you moves. The lungs fill, the belly rises, and blood is drawn toward the heart. One muscle in the middle moves, unseen, and the rest of you follows without being told. That is what this energy does with people.

It runs without an order, twenty thousand times a day, and takes one when you give it. Hold your breath and you have commanded it. Let go and it leads again on its own. Put a hand on your belly and breathe in. The belly comes out under your hand, pushed from above. You are feeling the one in the middle that the rest of you follows. Guidance has a chemistry in you, and valine is part of it. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from food, eggs or oats among them. The muscle you move with takes it apart for itself instead of leaving it to the liver. You share this chemistry with three other energies that together shape how people bond. What the four are for is leading together, with nothing ranked between you.

Guidance comes when you pause with someone and are truly together. Sit and talk about ordinary things, and what is needed comes out of the space between you. This is the deepest kind of guidance, and it happens through the body.

fields.essence: You want the people around you to know you as you really are, and the freedom to be yourself is what lets them. That freedom lives in the way you move and in the sound of your voice. You can lead an ordinary life on the outside and be wholly yourself inside it. The people who belong with you know you when they meet you.
fields.glance:
You want the people around you to know you as you really are, and the freedom to be yourself is what lets them. That freedom lives in the way you move and in the sound of your voice. You can lead an ordinary life on the outside and be wholly yourself inside it. The people who belong with you know you when they meet you.

At times you shape yourself to what others expect, because standing out feels unsafe. The same fear can make you work at looking different, which is still copying. Notice when you do it, and go back to what you actually want. If someone does not warm to you, you are still the same person.

Say what you mean in plain words, and let that be enough. Make the first move toward the people you feel drawn to, then give them time to come. The ones who stay with you come because they want to. Near you, other people start being themselves too.
fields.iching:
People come toward you, or you go to them, and the pull is real. Underneath it a quieter sorting goes on. Nobody builds it; you recognise it. Before you join anything, ask yourself three things and answer honestly. Is what you bring big enough, will it last, will it hold? If it will, you have nothing to answer for. The ones with no settled place will come to you from every side. They arrive one at a time, as they each make up their minds.

Force nobody and delay nothing. Whoever comes too late finds the door shut, and that is the one hard edge in a gentle time. If you are the one keeping people together, you do it from underneath, the way the ground carries water. The people standing on you lend you that strength. Start pulling at them and it goes. Keep to the kind who come of their own accord. Pass on whatever comes to you, down through everyone, and the belonging lasts.

Your belly is the part of you that takes this in, and your ear is where it reaches you first. What you hear goes down into you and stays, the way ground keeps rain. Sit low, let your middle soften, and let what belongs to you arrive. Water over Earth is the hexagram of finding the ones you belong with. Water is the restless part of you that goes out looking. Earth is the part of you that takes people in and holds them. The restlessness sits above because you go out long before you know where you will rest. This hexagram has long been read as water lying on the earth. The ground drinks the water and goes soft, and the water spreads until it is still. So you belong where you can come to rest as you are. Holding Together
fields.gene_keys:
Mediocrity Style Exquisiteness Style is what you are, flowering where anyone can see it. Living this takes a leap of faith in yourself. It has nothing to do with what you wear or how you live. Nobody can fake it or copy it, because it never passes through the mind on its way out. You are yourself without wondering what anyone thinks, and only other people call that a risk. Something creative takes hold of you rather than you of it. Once you have felt that freedom, whether it succeeds stops being the point.

It behaves like nature, which follows no plan at all. So anyone who keeps things running by rules finds it dangerous. It is wild, unplanned and full of leaps. So people push it to the edges, into art or music, where there is room for it. It does not need the edges. A person with this lives an ordinary outer life and a rebellious inner one. They walk through the market with everyone else, and you would still pick them out. Their freedom catches, and all they want is more people free. They stop dreaming the dream and start making it. Mediocrity is the fear of being different, and it wears the face of being sensible. You learned it in the years when sameness was rewarded and difference was corrected, and by now it feels like your own temperament. It is a stereotype you have worn so long that it keeps you safe. It keeps everyone else safe too, about who they think you are. Under it you think what everyone thinks and serve the machine that was here before you. You keep the machinery going instead of adding anything to it.

What you fear is not failing. It is succeeding, because becoming what you are would mean stepping past everything expected of you. You do not know who you would be out there. So you dream about the lives you might have had, watching other people live them on a screen, moved and going nowhere. Every child gives off a light, and yours went dim so gradually that you never caught the day it happened. You have fallen in love with what you are, and it is not vanity. Everywhere you look you see the same thing in other people, each one a diamond cut differently. Your nature is wild, and nothing tames it. You are never the same from one moment to the next, as fleeting as light through clouds. You lead nobody and leave no tracks to follow. The only strangers you know are the people who spend their lives copying someone else. They have become strangers to themselves. Water is weak, so nothing sticks to it, no plan and no grudge. You can rest completely, and resting is the last rebellion. A star at dawn and a bubble in a stream are gone while you look at them. So is all of this, and that is what makes it exquisite.
fields.human_design:
Contribution Something in you wants to add itself to the world and have it count. Gate 8 is the name for that pull. It is the urge to bring what only you see out where other people can use it, in your own words. With it comes the pressure to know when. Not every room wants it, and some ideas land nowhere. So you learn the hard way when to speak and when to keep the thing to yourself. What you are contributing in the end is yourself.

To other people it looks like someone who sets the fashion and does not mind standing out. What is really going on is quieter: they cannot be anyone but themselves. The cost is being misunderstood by people who wanted them to fit, and the loneliness that follows. Trying to be a model for others, by becoming someone they are not, is the one thing that wears them out.
fields.tarot: This self of yours shows most clearly when you stop holding a shape. It belongs to a family of two called the Ring of Water, and the other is UL 2, the open ground that receives everything. One takes in whatever falls on it, the other shines by its own nature, and the same chemistry runs through both. Open it when showing yourself has started to feel like work. Its family and its two trigrams bring five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, near this energy.
fields.body:
Of every organ, this energy is given to the thyroid, and the reason is the pace. Everything in you keeps one time, the warmth of your skin and the beat of your heart at rest. One small gland low in your neck sets that time, and it reaches every cell in you. It is two halves held as one by a bridge across your windpipe, about the weight of four coins.

You can feel that setting on a cold morning, in the warmth of your own hands, which is partly this gland's doing. Rest two fingers on the inside of your wrist and count. Fear can hurry that beat in a second, but the pace it settles back to was set weeks ago, here in your neck. The self in you that nobody can copy has a substance, and its name is phenylalanine. Twenty small pieces build every protein in you, and this is one of them. Your body cannot make it, so it has to arrive in your food, in eggs or beans. Once inside you it turns into the pigment that colours your eyes. It also becomes the hormone that sets your pace.

Deep in you this substance works with a second one, and the two of them draw you toward people unlike you. The push and pull inside you is settled down there, below anything you decide. You change from one day to the next while the same substance goes in and burns away. A river is never the same water and is still the river.

fields.essence: Determination lives in you as a love for the next small step. When what you want is still far off, you give your whole attention to what is in front of you today. Cooking a meal or washing a cup becomes a step toward what you want, so no chore feels wasted. There is ease in this: steps taken with heart wear a path, and the path starts to carry you.
fields.glance:
Determination lives in you as a love for the next small step. When what you want is still far off, you give your whole attention to what is in front of you today. Cooking a meal or washing a cup becomes a step toward what you want, so no chore feels wasted. There is ease in this: steps taken with heart wear a path, and the path starts to carry you.

Some days what you want feels so far away that today seems pointless. Your focus comes and goes in waves, so bring it back gently to one thing when it wanders. When a day leaves you cold, you have not chosen the wrong work; you have lost sight of what you are walking toward.

Put your heart behind each thing you do, and nothing is out of your reach. At the start of anything new, the first few steps set the direction for everything after. Small acts done in joy make more joy. Your smallest act counts for more than you know, to you and to everyone near you.
fields.iching:
A great strength in you is being held back by something much smaller than itself. The strength is real and ready, and still its time has not come. The clouds are thick and the rain has not fallen. It is not yet the moment for the big plan.

So store up what you have, and do the small things well. Keep your manners and your days in order, since those are what you can change now. Be like a shepherd who keeps a flock calm by staying calm, and lets the sheep find their own grass. When something blocks you, take it in without bitterness, and it becomes part of how you grow. Do not grab for a quick result. Do not grow so fond of small gains that they are all you ever have.

Your legs do the carrying now, while your head keeps the far aim in view. Wait the way a farmer waits under a heavy sky, with everything ready for the rain. Wind over Heaven is the hexagram of a great strength guided by something small. Heaven is the strength in you that wants to move. Wind is the gentle part of you that changes things a little at a time. The gentle sits above the strong because great strength is led best by kindness, never by force. This hexagram has long been read as thick clouds before the rain. The rain is gathering, and nothing you do will bring it sooner. Its name has also been read as raising animals and storing up food, and neither is done in a day. Your strength goes furthest under a gentle hand. Small Taming
fields.gene_keys:
Inertia Determination Invincibility Determination is one step, taken. The mind shows you the whole mountain at once, and your knees go weak just looking at it. So you look down at your feet instead, where there is one stone to step onto. That first step is the hardest, because the whole weight of staying put is against it. It is also the easiest, because it is only one step. Every step after it comes easier. If you fall off the path, that first step is what brings you back. Now the stones lead off over the horizon, and you do not need to see where.

The word sounds like force and gritted teeth, and it is nearly the opposite. The more determined you become, the less willpower it takes. Small acts done with heart build a momentum of their own. Break through once, and you know you can do it again. Inertia is what happens when the small things take hold of you. A path of stepping-stones runs in a circle, and you watch each stone as you step onto it. You never notice that the footprints are yesterday's. The errands and the things that do not matter take your life a little at a time. You feel busy and believe you are moving, while every step brings you back to the same place. Your enthusiasm goes, then your energy, and each loss feeds the other. What is left goes into complaining, out loud or under your breath.

Anything that is neither beautiful nor useful is trivia, and here it fills the days. Some days you make a great leap only to fall further, and it feels like you are back at the start. Invincibility lives in the weak, not the strong. It is a child running into a misty field at sunrise, soaked to the knees. Open like that, you cannot be beaten. There is no wall in you to break through. Love works this way: it only gives, so it is never emptied.

The smaller the thing you give yourself to, the more of your power goes into it. Held that way, one small thing in your hand can feel like all there is. People near someone who lives this can find them hard to bear. Their presence shows others what they most fear in themselves.
fields.human_design: Focus Gate 9 is the drive to put all your energy into one thing. It picks out the few details that serve the larger aim and lets the rest fall away. When it is on, you can work for hours on one thing and forget the room. It comes in waves, focus and then scatter, and the scatter is part of it. From outside the scatter is sometimes given a diagnosis, when it is only how this gate works. Once it is set on something it is hard to turn. Its danger is getting so lost in a detail that you lose sight of the whole. At its best it holds the detail and the whole at once.
fields.tarot: This energy builds great things out of small ones, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Light. UL 5, The Space Between Time, is the patience to wait for the right hour. UL 11, Sol Star, is the ideal that shows you where to walk. UL 26, Lighter Than a Feather, is the knack of getting a thing done unseen. This one is the step you keep taking. Through the ring and the two trigrams come five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana.
fields.body:
Walking is the reason this energy is given to the sacral plexus. From this weave of nerves at the base of your spine comes the largest nerve you have. It is about as wide as your thumb where it starts. It runs down the back of each leg to the foot, so every step you take begins here. The same low ground is where your will is kept. It is the part of you that goes on after the wanting has worn off.

Once you have taken the first step, the rest go on without your thinking about them. The rhythm is made low in your spine and reaches your legs through this weave. Sit on something hard and feel the two bones you sit on. A little to the outside of each, the nerve that walks you passes on its way down. The focus in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is threonine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with food such as eggs, meat or lentils. It is where your body switches a protein on or off, one of the commonest switches you have.

You share it with three other energies in you, and what they do together is gather light. This one brings the light to a single point, the way a lens focuses sunlight until it burns.

fields.essence: Ease lives in you as being at home in your own skin, through an ordinary day. You do things the way you do them, and nobody is being performed for. Your step stays light, even around people who could make things hard for you. Those near you relax, because your ease leaves them free to be at home in themselves. It is a treasure most people pass every day without stopping.
fields.glance:
Ease lives in you as being at home in your own skin, through an ordinary day. You do things the way you do them, and nobody is being performed for. Your step stays light, even around people who could make things hard for you. Those near you relax, because your ease leaves them free to be at home in themselves. It is a treasure most people pass every day without stopping.

Some days you cannot stop watching yourself, checking how you come across before you have said a word. That watching is what makes your step stiff. See it without judging it, and the looking wears itself out.

Take the easy way when it is there, even when the hard way feels more like you. The harder you struggle, the more you feel you exist, so ease can feel like doing nothing. Once you stop defining yourself, you feel part of something much wider. What you make from here has play in it, and it is new because you copied it from no one.
fields.iching:
You are walking close to a power bigger than you, someone with a say over your life, in a mood that could turn. Your task is to get through without being hurt. Nothing here is won by being stronger than the strong one. Keep your step light and your manner glad, because a glad step provokes nobody.

Know what is above you and what is below you, and pick your battles. Do not provoke the one who can bite, and do not freeze in fear either, because fright gets bitten too. Keep your kindness, and do not turn fierce yourself to feel safe. You are the one steering here, and others rise or fall with your choices. Go at a steady pace, neither rushing nor holding back.

Your feet do the work now. One goes, then the other, firm and soft by turns. Walk like that, and the dangerous stretch is how you come through. Heaven over Lake is the hexagram of how you walk when something stronger is near. Heaven is the strength in you that keeps pressing forward and never tires. Lake is the part of you that is open and glad and says what it feels. The strength sits above the gladness because most days you walk under a power bigger than your own. This hexagram has long been read as stepping on a tiger's tail and not being bitten. A glad step provokes no one, so whoever holds the power lets you pass. You come through close danger by walking as yourself. Treading
fields.gene_keys:
Self-Obsession Naturalness Being Naturalness is being what you already are, and nothing more. You are not your name, your feelings or your beliefs, and no label fits you. Once you feel that, the tightness around who you are lets go, and what the search held comes back as energy. It shows as play, and what you make is new because you copied it from nobody. You have nothing to defend, because you hold no position on yourself. The easy way opens in front of you, with places to rest along it and friends walking it.

You cannot practise this or copy it, because it has no method. It dawns as you see that everything in you is natural, the laziness and the pain included. Your edges soften, and you grow more open and more yielding. Your attention turns in on yourself and stays there. You worry about your clothes, your future and what people think of you. Even when you look calm, you are running from yourself into work and busyness, and rest is put off until Friday or the holidays. Underneath is a fear of losing who you are, so you set out to find yourself. The search becomes a maze full of drama, where you never have to face yourself. While you look at yourself you cannot see anyone else, and everyone you look at becomes someone you would like to change.

You need no judging and no fixing here. See the pattern in your life, and add nothing to it. The search wears itself out once you see that what it hunts cannot be found. Being is what is left when even the question of who you are has gone. There is nothing to find and no one looking for it. Life has no hidden meaning, only the beauty of this moment turning into the next. You see the whole search as a joke, and you laugh. This state is so ordinary that you would pass it in a room. Stay near it a while, and you would notice how tense you are yourself. There has never been anything to do, because there is no one to do it, and everything still gets done.
fields.human_design: The Behaviour of the Self Gate 10 sits in the middle of your chest and presses you to act as who you are. Its other name is self-love. When you love yourself, the people near you are freed to love themselves. When you do not, it is unbearable, and you push the feeling away by blaming others. At its best you live by your own values and stand up for them without fear of judgment. People follow the example you set more than anything you say. Left unchecked, it can turn into self-centredness.
fields.tarot: This energy finds your true self, and that is one chapter of a longer story. It belongs to a family of six, the Ring of Humanity, whose theme is the story every human life tells. UL 25, The Mysteries Play, carries the wound you start with. UL 38, Inner Light Symphony, carries the fight with your own shadows. UL 17, Pearl of Christos, carries the limits of the mind. UL 21, Beyond Binary, carries letting go of control. UL 51, Unshakable Arrival, carries the waking. This one carries finding yourself. Five of the tarot's major cards sit with this energy. Each shows you one side of being yourself.
fields.body:
Your heart beats as itself, and that is why this energy is given to the heart. Nothing tells it how to beat. A patch of cells in its own wall sets the pace, about once a second. A heart cut from every nerve goes on beating, as a transplanted heart does. The nerves only make it faster or slower. The heart rules the body by being in place, and the presence in your face comes from it.

It sits behind the breastbone, most of it left of the middle. Lay a flat hand there, or two fingers at the side of your neck. When you feel watched or afraid the beat quickens, and when that passes it settles. It was beating before you noticed, and it goes on when you stop. Being yourself has a chemistry in you, and one substance in it is arginine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from. Your body makes it for itself, so as an adult you do not need to eat it. As a growing child you could not make enough, and you took the rest from meat, milk or a handful of nuts.

You share this substance with a family of energies, and much of that family is about trusting your heart. Your body was making it before you knew your own name. It needs no effort from you, and it goes on whether or not you argue with your life.

fields.essence: Life changes when you stop reacting to whatever the day brings and start living toward something you chose. Idealism lives there, as a picture of how things could be. You set it higher than any sensible person would. It gets you out of bed in the morning, and every choice you make leans toward it. You feel it as a warmth in your chest long before any of it shows.
fields.glance:
Life changes when you stop reacting to whatever the day brings and start living toward something you chose. Idealism lives there, as a picture of how things could be. You set it higher than any sensible person would. It gets you out of bed in the morning, and every choice you make leans toward it. You feel it as a warmth in your chest long before any of it shows.
