There is one wave of feeling, and some people make it while others receive it. In love, neither of you pulls while the other pushes away, and what you share runs over like a full cup. You no longer fall in love; you rise in it. People can see the peace in your eyes.
fields.human_design: Spirit Gate 55 presses you to feel life at full depth and to be changed by what you feel. Every feeling that passes through it grows larger on the way. It wants your passion to be what supplies you, and it fears not knowing which passion to follow. At its best it makes things from faith that there is enough. Pressed by fear, it hoards, holds back or takes more than its share. Then it forces things by will until the will runs dry. From outside, all of this can look like plain moodiness.
fields.tarot: This energy works a quiet change inside your own life. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of the Whirlwind, bound by one chemistry. UL 49, Union in the Ashes, turns the same change outward into the upheaval you see when a whole society falls apart. Here it turns inward, and your moods stop running you. One of the tarot's major cards meets this energy twice, through the ring and the upper trigram.
fields.body:
The sun is the reason this energy is given to the solar plexus, which is named for it. Two knots of nerves, each the size of a fingertip, sit on the front of your spine behind your stomach. Fibres go out from them like rays to everything in your belly. They run your organs and vessels on their own, without a word from your brain. A strong feeling passes through them with more force than any thought you could set against it. A full day or an empty one is felt there first.

Lay a hand in the soft hollow just below the tip of your breastbone and take a sharp breath in. The hollow pushes out against your hand. The sun in the middle of you lies about a hand's depth behind it. Your body is getting ready for a change in its own cells as you read this, and so is every other body. One substance in that change is histidine. Your body cannot make it and has to take it in from milk, fish or lentils. In your blood, the iron that carries each breath is held in place by it. Every breath you take while reading is carried on it.

This energy has a chemistry in you that rises and lets go, the way the body does at the height of love. You share that chemistry with its kin, so what rises in you rises in them too.

fields.essence: Somewhere new, away from everything you know, your senses come wide awake. This is where delight lives in you. The food tastes of the place, and the light falls differently. You can tell what feeds you from what only passes the time.
fields.glance:
Somewhere new, away from everything you know, your senses come wide awake. This is where delight lives in you. The food tastes of the place, and the light falls differently. You can tell what feeds you from what only passes the time.

Some days you jump from one new thing to the next and cannot settle. Let yourself be bored for a while instead. When nothing is going on, you notice what is really there. That feeds you more than any rush.

Taste one thing at a time with your whole attention, and a little goes a long way. Leave room between one job or one home and the next. In that gap, what you gathered settles and becomes yours. Later it comes out of you as a story that other people love to hear. Lived like this, life is a journey that never runs out of things to taste.
fields.iching:
You are away from home, among people who do not know you. What counted where you came from counts for little here. Few people are close to you, and you are watched the way any stranger is watched. This is a time for small gains, and small gains are enough. Every place on the road is a place to pass through.

Travel light and carry only what you need. Be humble, and keep what you have out of sight. Keep your loyalties to yourself until you know the ground, and stay out of the local gossip. When you have to judge someone, judge clearly and let it end there. A guest who treats the house well is welcome to come back.

Your eyes do the work now, and they take in more than you can hold. Let them rest on one thing at a time, and keep your hands still. Sit the way a traveller sits at an inn, with the pack set down. Fire over Mountain is the hexagram of being a stranger far from home. Mountain is the stillness in you that stays in one place, wherever your feet go. Fire is your attention, bright and open to everything new. The stillness lies underneath because away from home there is nothing outside you to lean on. This hexagram has long been read as fire passing over a mountain. The mountain stays where it is like an inn, and the fire moves through it like a traveller. You can stay a night anywhere and leave the place as you found it. You travel well when you are still inside and wide awake outside. The Wanderer
fields.gene_keys:
Distraction Enrichment Intoxication Enrichment is something you stop doing more than something you do. Once you stop feeding the chase, whatever you do starts to feed you. You learn, in the moment, what nourishes you and what drains you. You would enjoy the cake, but today it would not do you good, so you let it pass. Another day you have it. This is choosing, and nothing is given up. There is a simple test: is there anything you cannot say no to? While there is, it has a hold on you.

The same energy that went out through your senses turns inward, toward where it came from. Real enjoyment starts inside you, and your senses grow finer. You find wonder where others find sameness, and beauty where others see something ugly. Under all the busyness sits an ache, an old longing with no name. You go looking for pleasure to be rid of it. The pleasure fades and leaves the ache deeper, so the two keep turning each other like a wheel. Out through the senses you go, to whatever is bright or loud, and while they are full you feel nothing underneath. Too much or too little, either one keeps you numb. Meanwhile the world tells you what to want and whose fault it is. Blame what happens to you, and the same pattern comes round again. Take it as it comes, and your life starts to move. Some turn the other way, into a private dream with no ground under it.

Switch off the screen and there it is, the ache you were running from. It was the one thing you needed to feel. Love is the arrow here, and you have let it pierce you again and again until nothing is left to defend. Keeping this takes no discipline at all. You are still distracted, but only by what lifts you. Nothing of the senses is given up. Everything is tasted slowly, the bitter as sweetly as the pleasant.

Of all the senses, the mouth takes life in deepest, and a kiss gives and takes at once. You laugh easily from here, having found there is no point to any of it, only wonder. The people near you catch it, the way a good wine is shared.
fields.human_design: Expansion Gate 56 sits in the throat and turns what you have lived into a story. It gathers first, place after place and person after person, then shapes what it found into something to say. It can make an ordinary day sound like an adventure. From outside it can look restless, a life that never settles on one thing. Its cost is talking more than listening. A story told from lack or struggle makes the people hearing it smaller, and one told from what is possible makes them bigger. The feeling behind a story counts as much as what happens in it. The right story, told to the right person at the right time, works like medicine. Silence can tell one too.
fields.tarot: This energy is how you forget yourself, out through the senses. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Trials, three tests every life meets again and again. The first belongs to UL 33, Echos of Time: forgetting who you are. The last belongs to UL 12, Petals of Freedom: giving up everything you have gained. This one carries the middle, the pull of the world through your five senses. Five of the tarot's major cards arrive here, and each shows one side of how you travel.
fields.body:
The journey is the reason this energy is given to the thyroid. Before you were born, the gland began at the back of your tongue. It travelled down the front of your neck to where it sits now, across the windpipe below the Adam's apple. It has not stopped moving since. It is tied to your voice box, so it rises every time you swallow. Put two fingers either side of your windpipe and swallow. What lifts under them is the voice box, with the gland going along. In a healthy neck you feel the lift and not the gland.

On the back of the thyroid sit four smaller glands, each the size of a grain of rice. Whatever you ate and wherever you are, they hold the calcium in your blood at one steady level. When it drops, they borrow from your bones and pay them back later. It is the one thing in your blood that does not wander. No substance in you belongs to this energy. What belongs to it is a stop. Your body builds each protein by reading a message one piece at a time. At a stop the reading ends, and the finished protein is let go whole. Every protein in you ends at a stop, and there is no other way one can end. Anywhere you looked in your body's own instructions, you would meet a stop every now and again.

In you, this stop is knowing exactly when to stop. It closes the places where your life leaks out, and your five senses are those places. As they close, your energy turns inward and a flame grows inside you that needs nothing from outside. It is the middle one of three such stops in you, the place where your senses lead you to forget yourself.

fields.essence: Before you have thought a choice through, your body often leans one way. That lean is intuition, a quiet knowing that speaks in the moment and gives no reasons. When you act on it at once, you move before doubt has had time to speak.
fields.glance:
Before you have thought a choice through, your body often leans one way. That lean is intuition, a quiet knowing that speaks in the moment and gives no reasons. When you act on it at once, you move before doubt has had time to speak.

It speaks once and softly, so the mind can talk over it. A worry and a hunch can feel alike in the body. The worry is about what might come, and the hunch is about now. When you cannot tell which is speaking, let the worry run its course before you decide.

Each time you trust it, it grows a little stronger. People soften toward you, and events move more smoothly than your worries predicted. It shows your own way, never anyone else's. When it leads you onto harder ground than you wanted, keep going, because the reason shows later. Followed gently, your hunches become a way through life that only you could have walked.
fields.iching:
You are in a situation that force will not move, and gentleness can. What works here is small, done again and again in one direction. You do not need to overturn anything here. Things are corrected a little, then a little more, the way wind shapes a field over a season. The strength of it comes from time. You come to this after a stretch with no place of your own, so going in gently is the only way open.

Have somewhere to go, then walk there step by step on the same path. Do not change course at every gust. Look below the surface, where the matter is really decided, and weigh each move by where you stand. Find someone who has done this before, and put yourself in front of them. The gains will be small, and they will hold.

Your legs do the work now, carrying you forward one steady step at a time. Walk softly, and keep walking. Wind over Wind is the hexagram of getting through by gentleness. Wind is the part of you that goes in softly and keeps going. Here it meets more of itself, so each small effort you make is followed by another. A single gust passes and changes nothing. Wind that keeps blowing one way bends a whole field. This hexagram has long been read as wind following wind, and as a root going into the ground. A root finds the soft places between stones, and your patience works like that. You get where you are going by staying gentle and staying on course. The Gentle Wind
fields.gene_keys:
Unease Intuition Clarity Trust is something you can live inside, and you move into it by listening. Intuition is the part of you that already knows the way out of the maze. It is a quiet voice, softer than thought, and nature speaks to you through it. Much of the time you hear it without following it, which is how you learn. The fear stays for a while. Then the knowing grows stronger than the old habits, and your body hums with life.

The mind explores and conquers, while this listens and receives. When the listening leads and the mind follows, you feel at ease in your body, perhaps for the first time. Fear turns out not to be inside you at all. It is a field you can live in, pass through or rise above. Sit still in a quiet room for a few minutes, and a discomfort starts up underneath with nothing it is about. It is a sense that all is not quite as it should be. It comes with living in a body that will not last, and it drives much of what you want and fear. Once it was a warning that went off only when danger was near. Now the mind picks it up and turns it into worry that never stops. You hum at whatever pitch is played beside you, the way a tuning fork does. Most of the world around you is playing fear. So you build safety out of money and plans, and the unease stays behind them. No amount of thinking ends it, because thinking is what keeps it going.

Turning to face it takes courage, since looking away is easy. It does not leave when you look. Once you can see it, it stops driving you. The surprise, when it comes, is how gentle it is. The listening that guided you leads to an edge, and there it leaves you. You wait at that threshold, where the oldest fears live. Then something takes your hand, and you slip through. There is no path after that, because you have arrived. There is no fear, because there is no tomorrow.

You stop humming to whatever is played beside you, and everything goes quiet. What remains is softness at the heart of everything, like wind moving through the top of a tree. The more softly you touch a thing, the more it opens to you. Gentleness turns out to have no weakness in it.
fields.human_design:
Intuitive Clarity Gate 57 presses you to know, right now, whether you are safe. It works through the senses and takes in the whole moment before thought can weigh it. It picks up a change in a room, or something coming before it has arrived. More than once it has moved you out of harm's way without your deciding anything. The knowing comes whole, with no reason attached, and it comes once.

Because no reason comes with it, a hunch is easy to argue away, especially when it goes against what everyone thinks. There is a second trap. You sense so much that you throw it forward and frighten yourself with a future you have made up. Nobody knows the future. What the pressure is for is timing: knowing when the moment is right, then moving in it instead of second-guessing what you already know.
fields.tarot: This energy lays down the first pattern of your body, in the nine months before birth. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Matter, whose theme is a body growing from conception to the age of twenty-one. UL 46, Fountain of Light, carries the first seven years. UL 48, Doorways of the Unknown, carries the second seven. UL 18, Liberation of the Greater, carries the third. This one carries the time in the womb. One of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrives through the family.
fields.body:
Your spleen does its work without ever telling you, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is the one organ in your belly that you cannot feel. It lies under your left ribs, behind the stomach. All of your blood passes through it many times a day. It meets whatever should not be in the blood before anything in you hurts. It has no duct and no nerve that reports to you, so none of this reaches you as a feeling. Taste works in the same instant way, deciding before any thought whether a thing is safe to swallow.

Lay a hand flat on your left side, under the last ribs, and breathe in. You feel nothing there. A healthy spleen is about the size of a fist, and no hand can find it. Your hand is resting on the part of you that knows first and says nothing. This energy has a chemistry in your body, and one substance in it is alanine. Your body makes it for itself, though meat, eggs and beans all carry it too. Only one of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from is smaller. If you have had a blood test, you may have seen the letters ALT, which name the enzyme that makes it and takes it apart.

The unease in you came in at conception. Your body was built at the pitch of the world your mother lived in while she carried you. This is the oldest pattern written into you, the one that makes the world feel solid, and it was made to be unlocked. You share this chemistry with three other energies.

fields.essence: Some mornings you wake up glad to be alive, for no reason you could name. You want to tell someone, so you call a friend, and your good mood spreads to the people near you. You see how the things in front of you could be a little better, and making them better is a pleasure.
fields.glance:
Some mornings you wake up glad to be alive, for no reason you could name. You want to tell someone, so you call a friend, and your good mood spreads to the people near you. You see how the things in front of you could be a little better, and making them better is a pleasure.

Joy has its own rhythm, and on some days it goes quiet. A restlessness takes its place, a feeling that life should be more than it is. Chasing the next plan or purchase will not bring the joy back any sooner. Let the restlessness be, and the gladness returns on its own.

Do something kind that nobody asked for, and notice how much more alive you feel. When you see what could be better, wait until someone asks, and your help will be welcome. Shared this way, joy comes back to you as more life, and the people around you feel it too.
fields.iching:
Things are going well, and it is a time to enjoy them with other people. The work is done or on its way, and a celebration is in order. Gather your friends, talk over what each of you has learned, and practise it together. What you learn alone stays thin. Talked through with a friend, it deepens for both of you.

Stay firm inside while you are warm outside. Win people with friendliness, never by pressure. Honest joy shows in your face, and people trust it. Joy put on to draw people in turns sour. Be a little careful whom you open to, since some who come near your good mood want something from it.

When you lead people with joy, they forget how tired they are. When you face a hard thing beside them with joy, they forget their fear. Your mouth is where this joy shows first, in talk, laughter and food. Notice whether what you said today had any pleasure in it, and spend your talk and your meals with people who are good for you. Lake over Lake is the hexagram of joy that is shared. Lake is the joy in you that you cannot hide. Here it meets the same joy in someone else. A lake on its own dries down in the sun. Two lakes keep each other full. That is why its image is friends gathered to talk a thing through. So the joy in you wants to be spoken. Your joy grows only when someone else has it too. The Joyous Lake
fields.gene_keys:
Dissatisfaction Vitality Bliss Aliveness wells up once you stop chasing a better tomorrow. The force that poured out into the future turns back into your body, and the water starts to move freely. You are happy for no reason. Your thoughts slow, with more space between them, and what happens to you matters less. Even an old or tired body feels younger for it.

Loss is part of this joy. The people you have lost stay part of you, and your life is fuller for them. The wish to make things better is still here, but it no longer helps in order to ease your own ache. It feels where life is stuck in something and frees it without forcing. Walk into a room with this alive in you, and the room moves more easily. Under most lives runs a restlessness with no cause. It is not sadness or worry, which have a reason. It is only the feeling that this is not quite it yet, always pointed at tomorrow. Picture a lake whose surface never settles, and you have what it is like inside. Your mind takes it as an order to fix something, so you improve the house, the job or yourself. Each change calms the water for a day, then the restlessness stirs it again. When the world runs out of things to fix, the search turns inward, to a practice or a teacher who promises peace later. That is the same search in different clothes.

The restlessness will not let you rest until every answer has been tried. The emptiness left then is the first honest thing it gives you. Everyone carries this same ache, the ache to come home, and there is something beautiful in that. Bliss is the lake gone still. Your seeking turns so far inward that it comes back to where it began. Something lets go at the very bottom, and you no longer feel a centre inside you. Nobody stirs the water any more, so it stays still. Awareness comes in like a flood and wipes you clean in less than a breath. Your gaze goes soft, your heart fills past what it can hold, and it shows in your face.

You cannot reach this by seeking, though seeking usually comes first. Look at your own restlessness until you can laugh at it. Then you see the joy was inside the ache all along, as the fruit is inside the seed.
fields.human_design:
Joy Gate 58 is the drive to make life better because being alive is good. You feel it low in your body, a lively pressure that sees how whatever is in front of you could be more alive. For you, joy and improving things go together. Practice feeds it: you do the same thing again and again because the doing is a pleasure, and your skill grows.

It has two costs. Offered before anyone asks, your idea of what could be better is heard as criticism. When it is refused, it feels as if you were refused. The other cost runs inward. If you were taught that pleasure must be earned, you ration what you love and call it discipline. The joy was never a distraction from the work, since it is what drives it.
fields.tarot: This energy is one of six pressures in the Ring of Seeking, each keeping you looking for more until it turns you inward. UL 15, Ordinary Valiance, is the pull people feel toward you when you slow down. UL 39, Nobel Spark, is the push in you that stirs what has gone still. UL 52, Timeless Blossom, is the restraint that lets you hold pressure without acting on it. UL 53, Creation Oscillation, is your urge to begin. UL 54, Everlasting Bounty, is your wish to rise. This one is your joy in being alive. Three of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show your joy from three sides.
fields.body:
Fear takes hold first at the perineum, and that is why this energy is given to it. It is the small sling of muscle at the floor of your body, between the legs. When you are afraid, it tightens before you know it, and the grip climbs the spine into your jaw. Held tight, it puts you on automatic, doing the next thing without being there to choose it. The restless feeling that life should be more can live here for years, as a floor held tight and a breath kept high.

Laugh, and the floor tightens a moment before the laugh comes. It is the same muscle you use to stop the flow of urine. Squeeze it now and notice your breath rise. Let it go, and your breath drops on its own, with your shoulders after it. The restlessness in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is serine. It is one of the twenty pieces every protein in you is built from, and there is plenty of it in meat, eggs and beans. When you eat, the juices in your gut cut the food into those twenty pieces, and serine is part of what does the cutting.

You share this substance with a family of pressures, each driving you to look for an end to your longing. That longing is fuel. As it falls away, the life in you runs clearer. Even bliss is chemistry: a release in the brain, felt as joy with no cause.

fields.essence: When someone comes close, a longing rises in you to be known by them. You feel it in your body first. You let them see you as you are. You say what is true, and your heart decides how much to share. You listen as closely as you speak.
fields.glance:
When someone comes close, a longing rises in you to be known by them. You feel it in your body first. You let them see you as you are. You say what is true, and your heart decides how much to share. You listen as closely as you speak.

Some days you pull back from someone and cannot say why. Turn toward the feeling instead of away from it. Most often it is old pain. Hold it the way you would hold a frightened child, and in time it lets go of you.

Be honest with your own heart, and you can be honest with anyone. Once you no longer need the other person to change, your heart stays open whatever they do. What you kept hidden, once opened, turns out to hold love. Near you, other people feel free to be honest too.
fields.iching:
Something between you and other people has set hard, and now it is breaking up. It may be a suspicion, a grudge, or a group you have held on to out of habit. While it breaks up it can feel like a loss. It is a thaw.

What it asks first is warmth from inside you. Nobody else can warm you up. Whatever you send out carries your own warmth or your own cold.

This time has long been pictured as a king who goes to his temple when his people are scattered. When people have drifted away from you, do not try to drive them back. Be sincere where they can see it, and they come back on their own. Let go of what ought to go, and what matters can come together again. This is a good time for a large undertaking, like a boat on wide water with the wind behind it.

In the body, it is energy that was blocked inside you starting to move again. Stay warm, stay sincere, and be ready to cross. Wind over Water is the hexagram of a thaw between people, when what had set hard breaks up. Water is the feeling in you that has been held down with nowhere to go. Wind is the gentle pressure in you that finds its way into a closed place. The wind sits above because a feeling locked inside rarely frees itself, and something has to reach it. This hexagram has long been read as ice breaking up and melting. A warm wind over a frozen pond turns the ice back into water, while a cold one freezes it harder. What is warm in you frees what has gone cold between you and another person. Dispersion
fields.gene_keys:
Dishonesty Intimacy Transparency Intimacy starts when you let the fear between you be there. You admit it, understand it and leave it alone. That allowing works like a valve, and the full force of attraction pours out. It is not soft. It is the raw power that makes new life, and it breaks up whatever kept two people apart.

When two people meet like this, something forms between them that neither had alone. The more different the two of you are, the further it can take you. The force rises until it reaches the heart, where two people share one awareness. The nearest most people come to it is falling in love, when you feel the other person even from far away. A part of you stays hidden from other people, and it came with you. When someone walks into the room, a faint fear starts up in the air between you. Alone, you do not feel it. As long as you keep something back, the other person has something to fear. That fear is also what draws two people together, and once you stop fearing someone the pull goes. Most of this is not a lie you choose to tell.

It starts inside, in the story you tell yourself about why you did what you did. The story puts the blame on someone else. So you change your partner or move to another country, and the same knot ties itself again. Under it is old pain, stacked in the body, much of it handed down to you. This is what makes a room full of people feel lonely. Transparency is what is left when there is nothing in you to hide. You see the world the way a clear mirror does, adding no comment and no judgement. The last wall to go is the one between you and everyone else, and then nobody feels like a stranger.

Every man and woman is your brother or sister, and no one is an island. Two people joined this way are not parted by distance, or even by death. Fear turns out to have been a thin skin you had to pass through.
fields.human_design:
Sexuality Gate 59 is the drive to break through a barrier and get close to someone. At its root it is the urge to make new life. It chooses whom you are drawn to without asking you. Beyond that root it reaches for people of every kind, wanting to understand them and be understood.

Its question is where, and with whom. The same force can make a partnership or a business thrive, or start a pregnancy nobody wanted. The strength that takes a wall down can also be used to push past someone's limits or to get your way. So be clear before you act on it.
fields.tarot: This energy takes down the barriers between people, and its family turns on it. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Union, whose aim is to bring people together as one family. UL 4, Veils of Knowledge, carries the understanding that lets you stop blaming. UL 7, Essential Nexus, carries the guidance that comes when you are truly together. UL 29, All In, carries the commitment that holds nothing back. This one carries your closeness to one other person. Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.
fields.body:
New life is the reason this energy is given to the sacral plexus and the sexual organs. The sacral plexus is a weave of nerves low in your pelvis. Its nerves carry the feeling between your legs and ready your body for another body without a thought from you. Close by lie the ovaries or the testes, where the start of a new person is made.

Everyone you have ever met is here because this place did its work in two other people, and so are you. It is also the part of you least under your control. Nothing here waits for your permission, and nothing here can be argued into readiness. The longing for union with another has a substance in you, and the substance is valine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from food, more from a bowl of oats than from white rice. When food runs short, your body can turn it into sugar.

You share this substance with three other energies, and together they have long shaped how people are with each other. In you it runs from forgiving yourself, to the goodness that follows, to pouring yourself out for others. Then it comes to this closeness, where there is no inside left to keep anything in.

fields.essence: You have an idea you want to make real, and it needs a shape before it can stand. Common sense is what finds that shape. You know what a thing will cost, how long it will take and how much one day can hold. You set the edges first and build inside them. People come to you when they want something to actually get done.
fields.glance:
You have an idea you want to make real, and it needs a shape before it can stand. Common sense is what finds that shape. You know what a thing will cost, how long it will take and how much one day can hold. You set the edges first and build inside them. People come to you when they want something to actually get done.

Some days you are pulled two ways, toward the next big reach and back toward what feels safe. Go too far toward the reach and you burn out. Go too far toward safety and you shrink. You need the structure, and you need to be free of it at the same time.

So build what the idea needs, and hold the frame lightly. Make it the kind that bends when the ground moves under it. Then what you imagined has a place in the world, and it lasts.
fields.iching:
More is coming in than you can hold, and it needs a limit before it can be of use. A lake must hold its water without spilling over or drying out. So its level is checked all the time. Set a good limit, and things go well. What you set now is how much you will spend, how far you will go and what you will not do.

Then weigh what you do against those measures. A good measure harms nothing you own and hurts no one near you. Keep your measures sweet, and they will feel like your own. A rule that has turned bitter cannot be kept for long, and holding on to it only leads you to a dead end.

The body knows this in its joints. A knee or a knuckle is where one bone stops and the next begins, and that is why a limb can move at all. Sit easy, with every joint loose. Water over Lake is the hexagram of how much you can hold. Lake is the part of you that is content inside its own shore. Water is everything that keeps pouring in, the work and the money to spend. The flow sits above because more always arrives than any one place can keep. This hexagram has long been read as the joints of a bamboo stalk. Each joint ends one length and starts the next, which is how the cane grows so tall. The year has joints too, which is why it turns through four seasons. You grow the same way, one measured length at a time. Limitation
fields.gene_keys:
Limitation Realism Justice Realism is knowing how a new idea becomes a real thing. A good idea will not arrive in the world on its own. It needs a shell, the way a seed does, or it never takes root. So you graft the new shoot onto an old, strong root, and change grows out of what already stands. All a new thing needs is some structure and an open mind.

You know that every structure you build will end one day, and you can smile about it. Knowing this keeps you from being trapped inside what you built. So you set up the easel or open the shop, and you begin from the heart. Something breaks through in the gap between what you meant and what you made. The best of this gift is knowing when to step back and let the thing go. Closed thinking is the low of this energy. Your mind goes round the same track as yesterday, about your partner or your money. Nothing new gets in, because you keep no door open for it. Out in the world it is red tape, rules so tangled they no longer protect anyone. It is a child kept at a desk when every part of them wants to run. It cannot bear anything new or young.

Under it is a lack of trust. Life puts itself right in its own time, and this part of you cannot believe that. So it holds everything still. It will not move for force. It waits for one thing, which is time. Justice here is a gift given, never a punishment. A man once stole the silver from the one house that had taken him in. Caught and brought back, he heard the owner say the silver had been a present. Being forgiven by someone you wronged cracks you open. Life evens the balance, and nobody has to punish anyone.

What drops away at this height is weight. Let go of your past, and you become light, in both senses of the word.
fields.human_design: Conservation Gate 60 is the pressure to bring something new into form within set limits. Its name here is Conservation, which means keeping what still works. In a time of change or loss, it keeps your eyes on what is still standing rather than on what fell. That is what lets you rebuild. Its gift is a lotus that grows up out of the mud. When nothing shows, you can feel that something is wrong with you. Nothing is wrong, since the seed is growing under the ground where you cannot see it.
fields.tarot: This energy gives the earth its weight. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, through which you can feel your kinship with every living thing. UL 19, Solection, is the part of you that can feel what it is like to be another creature. UL 61, Celestial Remembrance, is the part of you that knows the truth at the heart of things. This one is the solid ground under your feet, where both of them stand. The tarot gives this energy one of its major cards, its Arcana, and it speaks to what you grow.
fields.body:
The banks are the reason this energy is given to the colon. A river without banks is a flood, and the colon is the bank inside you. About a litre and a half of liquid reaches it each day. It takes all but a cupful of the water back into your blood, so what arrived loose leaves with a shape. It holds what it has for a day or two. Then it moves in a few long pushes, most often after the first meal of the day. Only at the very end does one muscle wait for your decision.

Lie on your back and press in low on the left, below the navel. When it is full, you may feel a firm rope under your fingers, the last bend. That is the part of you that gives the day's leftovers a shape. The weight you carry has a chemistry, and one substance in it is isoleucine. Your body cannot make it, so it comes from meat, cheese or beans. This energy is the earth at its most solid, the plain weight of things. Your muscles take the substance apart themselves, in the part of you that works against the pull of the ground.

You share it with two other energies. One of them is the moment a thought breaks out of its old track. So what keeps you steady and what sets your mind free share one chemistry.

fields.essence: Inspiration is alive in you, and it begins with a question you cannot work out by thinking. You carry the question through your day, and it keeps you wondering. Then something comes in that you did not think, and afterwards you see your life a little differently. It feels less like learning something new than like remembering it.
fields.glance:
Inspiration is alive in you, and it begins with a question you cannot work out by thinking. You carry the question through your day, and it keeps you wondering. Then something comes in that you did not think, and afterwards you see your life a little differently. It feels less like learning something new than like remembering it.

Some days the question presses, and your thoughts go round and round. Your mind will grab any answer that promises to end the pressure, and none of them lasts. Leave the question open, because the next flash comes in its own time. Between flashes the days can go flat.

When your mind is troubled, pick up a pencil or a trowel and make something. As the work takes shape, the worry empties out and only what matters is left. Other people feel it in what you make, and they are drawn to it. Each flash goes into your hands and comes out as something real.
fields.iching:
Here your word is believed, because there is nothing hidden behind it. It reaches even the people who trust nobody, the ones no argument can move. A small offering made honestly counts for more than a grand one made for show. With this behind you, you can take on something large and hard and see it through.

What it asks is an open heart with no hidden plan in it. Go in empty, the way an empty boat crosses a wide river. When someone has done wrong, take your time before you judge them. Find out why they acted as they did, and answer them instead of reacting.

Sincerity is felt in the chest before anyone sees it. Keep your chest open and your plans in plain sight, and speak from there. Wind over Lake is the hexagram of the truth you hold inside. Lake is the openness in you that shows on your face and in what you say. Wind is the gentleness in you that reaches people without pushing. The openness sits inside and the gentleness outside, because what is true in you reaches others only when nobody is pushed. This hexagram has long been read as wind moving over open water. Nobody sees what you hold inside, but everyone sees what it moves in them. The less you push, the further you reach. Inner Truth
fields.gene_keys:
Psychosis Inspiration Sanctity Inspiration means breath coming in, and this energy at its best is exactly that. Something enters you that you did not think, and it takes apart a piece of what the mind had built. The energy locked up in that building is set loose, and it wants to become something. What comes out of you is your own, unlike anyone else's.

A man loses his wife, and for a year he rises at dawn and pours his grief into a garden. At the end there is a garden, a clear mind and something made for her. Being born in a body means being born wounded, and this is how the wound is tended. As you tend your own, you begin to tend it in others. Losing touch with what is real is the ordinary state of most minds, and almost nobody knows they are in it. Here it starts as the question why, and a pressure to answer it that the mind cannot bear. One side of the mind reaches for a faith to end it, and the other side reaches for a science. Neither of them can end the pressure. The mind is sick for one reason: it is looking for itself. You cannot think your way out from inside the thinking.

The worst of it is worship. The moment you put someone above you as the one who knows, you set yourself below them and stay there. The only way through is to walk into the pressure instead of trying to make it stop. Do it slowly, in your body, with your feet on the ground. Holiness is what is left when inspiration has used itself up. A great silence comes down, and all the noise of the mind stops at once. The pressure leaves the head and goes out through the whole of you, everywhere at once. You feel empty and full at the same time, and the sense of someone watching it is gone. The question why is never answered here. It ends, and what remains is living without answers. It arrives as a glimpse, and then you fall and begin the work again. One night you sit alone on open rock and watch the full moon rise, and there is nothing more to ask.
fields.human_design:
Wonder Gate 61 is the drive to know why, and its name is Wonder. It reaches past what can be explained toward the mystery itself, and comes back with a knowing it cannot account for. You know things without being able to say how, and you know them all the same.

From outside it can look like being lost in thought, and it is often misunderstood. Nobody around can confirm what it knows, so doubt creeps in. Left to run, the need to figure things out turns bitter. The story of why things happened takes the place of wonder that they happened at all. Let the answer go and keep the wonder. Being present turns out to hold more than knowing.
fields.tarot: This energy looks inward, where every living thing keeps its truth. It belongs to a family of three, the Ring of Gaia, whose theme is the life of the whole planet. UL 19, Solection, carries the closeness that lets you feel what another creature feels. UL 60, Woven Light, carries the limit that gives life its form. This one carries the question hidden inside everything. Three of the tarot's major cards arrive here, one through the ring and two through the Wind.
fields.body:
The dark is the reason this energy is given to the pineal gland. The gland sits in the very middle of your head, the size of a grain of rice. Nearly everything in the brain comes in pairs, and this one is single. It never sees light, and it learns from your eyes when the day has gone. While the light is on it does nothing, and when the light goes it begins its work. The question in you rises the same way, from a part of the mind no light reaches.

Sit in a dim room in the evening, and over an hour or two your body slows and grows heavy. That is this gland at work. Turn on a bright light and within minutes it stops. You cannot feel it working, only what it brings. The pressure of the mystery in you has a substance, isoleucine, one of the twenty pieces that build every protein in you. Your body cannot make it, so it comes in with food such as meat, eggs or beans. It has a twin of exactly the same weight, built from the same pieces in a slightly different order. The two are not the same thing, and the difference is inside, where nobody can see it.

Deep in your body the pressure of the mystery beats in every part of you. Whatever is of real value in you is hidden inside, never on the surface. You share this one substance with two other energies.

fields.essence: Precision comes alive in you on the days when only small things can be done. You see the detail everyone else walked past, and you put it right. Before you speak there is a pause in your throat while the right word arrives. You say that word and stop. This is precision the way nature has it, with the seasons arriving on time and no clock to keep them.
fields.glance:
Precision comes alive in you on the days when only small things can be done. You see the detail everyone else walked past, and you put it right. Before you speak there is a pause in your throat while the right word arrives. You say that word and stop. This is precision the way nature has it, with the seasons arriving on time and no clock to keep them.

Some days the details become a place to hide. The lists grow so that you never reach the feeling underneath. At other times you plan and plan for fear of not being ready. When you catch this, put the list down and feel what it was keeping away.

Give the small thing your full care, and leave the big step until its time comes. Say less, and let your heart choose what you say while your mind only finds the words. Then people lean in when you speak, because every word you say is one you mean.
fields.iching:
This is a time when small things can be done and great things cannot. The stir in you wants the big move, and the ground under you holds it back. What gets through is what stays close. A little too little is safer now than a little too much.

Go a little past the usual in the small things, always on the side of modesty. Be a little more respectful than the occasion needs. When you lose someone, mourn with more feeling than show. Spend a little less. Do the near thing a little better than anyone else would, and climb one step at a time. Reaching for the great thing now costs more later than it gains today.

Your feet want to go, and your hands keep things in their place. Let your hands be busy with the near thing, and keep your feet on the ground. Thunder over Mountain is the hexagram of small things done well. Thunder is the part of you that wants to move and be heard. Mountain is the part of you that knows where to stop. The stillness sits underneath because every move you make now has to come out of it. This hexagram has long been read as a bird leaving its call as it flies. A call sent down to the ground is heard, and a call sent up into the sky is lost. So keep your voice near the people it is for. You go further now by doing small things a little better than by reaching for a great one. Small Preponderance
fields.gene_keys:
Intellect Precision Impeccability Precision starts on the day the questioning turns around on itself. If you were lost in details, you begin to ask why. If you used facts to win, you see that the misery was your own, from years of looking at anything but your own pain. Then it is as if someone cleaned the windows. You look at the tree and take in its life before you reach for its name.

You can tell which patterns are true and which only look true, and you put things and people where they belong. Your words get more exact, and people cannot help listening. It takes some nerve, because you risk being laughed at for speaking from the heart. A name is not the thing it names, and the clever mind lives on names. Look at a tree through it and you see what you were taught about it. You see its name and its kind, and you miss the tree. Every fact needs a name, so a life built on facts is built out of words, and words shift. Today's facts become tomorrow's fables. Your days run on numbers, on the clock and in the bank. Much of what you call the world is only what someone said about it.

You were not born this way. A child's intelligence is in how it moves and how its eyes shine, and schooling fills the head until that brightness goes quiet. Intelligence belongs to the heart and cleverness to the head, and the head will argue to the end rather than give way. Impeccability comes when you are no longer the one trying to get it right. Your words stop passing through your thinking. They come up out of your own silence, plain, and you need fewer of them the further this goes. What counts now is the moment of making, and not what gets made. A song that no one hears still counts, because the moment of singing it stays.

Nothing in you is out of place, the cracks included. A bowl mended with gold is worth more than one that never broke. The woodpecker finds its food and its home in a dead tree. You find what you need in the parts of your life you tried to leave behind.
fields.human_design:
Preparation Gate 62 drives you to get ready. It takes something vast and gives it a handle you can hold. You gather the facts and the small things, so nothing is missing when the time comes. It breaks a hard idea into plain steps that others can follow. This makes yours a voice of reason, grounded on what can be checked.

It goes wrong as over-preparing. The plan becomes more important than what it was for, and the lists grow to keep the fear of not being ready away. Meanwhile the day goes by unattended. Trust that you will know what you need to know when you need to know it.
fields.tarot: This energy chooses its words, and it cannot take them back once they are said. It belongs to a family of two, the Ring of No Return, whose theme is the words you cannot unsay. Its one kin is UL 31, Theater of Truth, where your words move a whole room. This one finds the exact word for you. Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, show this energy in faces you may already know.
fields.body:
The hum is the reason this energy is given to your throat. Every word you say begins as a small hum there. Two folds no longer than a fingernail flutter there a hundred times a second or more. Your tongue and lips cut that hum into words on the way out. As a baby you had only these sounds, a sigh or a groan. You learned to speak by shaping them. Low in the front of your throat sits the thyroid. Its whole day's work is a fleck, held within a narrow band. That small amount sets the pace of your whole body.

Lay a hand flat on your throat and hum. The buzz under your palm is your voice before it becomes a word. Now whisper the same word, and the buzz is gone. A whisper is only breath, and what you felt a moment ago is what every word of yours is made from. The sureness in your body has a substance, and one part of it is tyrosine. What your head is sure of can be argued away. What your body is sure of cannot, and the one thing it is sure of is love. Your body makes tyrosine for itself, so it is never missing. As your words become more exact, your heart shows through them.

A word, once spoken, does not come back. The substance it was spoken through was made in you before you chose the word. You share it with one other energy, the one that leads people with words. Break an old hard cheese and you find white grains that crunch. Those grains are tyrosine, the same substance your own body makes.

fields.essence: Curiosity comes alive in you once something is finished. You want to know how it works, so you take it apart piece by piece. What you learn on the way matters more than the answer. You spot the detail that does not fit, the one others walk past. Your questions leave things simpler and better ordered for everyone who uses them.
fields.glance:
Curiosity comes alive in you once something is finished. You want to know how it works, so you take it apart piece by piece. What you learn on the way matters more than the answer. You spot the detail that does not fit, the one others walk past. Your questions leave things simpler and better ordered for everyone who uses them.

Some days the questions turn into doubt about yourself. Talk it over with someone you trust, and it passes through.

Look at a thing whole before you take it apart, and let its beauty reach you first. Hold every answer lightly, the way a child holds a game. In time your questions turn inward, to who you really are. Follow them there, and your mind comes to rest, like sitting under a tree after a long day's walk.
fields.iching:
The crossing is behind you, and what you set out to do is done. Every part of it is in its place. What is left is small, the settling in and the tidying up. This is where the danger lies. A thing in perfect order can move only one way, toward disorder. People stop watching once a matter is settled, and that is when they are most exposed. So the good fortune comes at the start of this time, and the disorder at its end.

Think about trouble while there is none, so you are ready when it comes. Keep going in the small things the way you did in the large ones. Think of the people who depend on what you have built, and put their good before your own. Know more than you use, and keep some of your strength back.

Your eyes and ears do the work now. The eyes go over what is finished. The ears catch the first drip of a leak. Sit the way someone sits when the day's work is done, with loose hands and open ears. Water over Fire is the hexagram of what comes after a thing is done. Fire is the clarity in you that sets each part of your work where it belongs. Water is the part of you that knows where the danger still is. The watching sits above the order because once a thing is done, keeping it is the work that is left. This hexagram has long been read as a pot of water over a flame. Tend both, and the water boils. Let either run wild, and it puts an end to the other. You are never more at risk than when everything is in its place. After Completion
fields.gene_keys:
Doubt Inquiry Truth Inquiry is doubt put to work. You can ask all your life without needing an answer to end it. A mind that fixes on one answer as the truth must defend it, and someone will always attack. An open mind has nothing to defend. It has the lightness of a child at play.

Ask deeply enough into anything and you find you are part of what you are looking at. From there the asking turns inward. What am I, asks the mind. What is love, asks the heart over and over, and it needs no final answer. A mind kept open grows soft, and an open mind opens the heart. Uncertainty is a pressure most people cannot bear. Whatever you settle, the doubt moves on to the next thing, and nothing ends it. So people take on a firm set of beliefs and hold them up against the doubt like a wall. Anyone who offers to end your uncertainty for good is selling you something false. Doubt is not the enemy. It turns harmful when you make it personal. Pushed out, it falls on the people closest to you. Turned in, it becomes doubt about yourself.

Here the mind works in the wrong order. Shown a sunset, it hears only its own words about it and is already thinking of tomorrow. Take a thing in first, and examine it after. Truth arrives when the question swallows the one asking it. You climbed for years toward an answer and wore yourself out on the way. At the top you found it had been at the foot all along, before you took a step. Trusted far enough, doubt turns out to be the truth itself, and the doubter dissolves into it.

Then there is rest, like sitting under a tree on a warm evening after walking all day. Every sigh brings you nearer to it, and so does every time your face softens. It is your plain state, closer than your own heartbeat. It is there at every step of the way.
fields.human_design: Curiosity Gate 63 sits at the top of your head and asks what comes next. It looks ahead to see which path will hold, what to follow and what to leave. It works by testing the next step before you take it, and it can tell a real teacher from a fake. Its fear is being wrong. Under the fear is a craving for certainty that no next step can meet.
fields.tarot: This energy asks, and asking is how every search begins. It belongs to a family of four, the Ring of Divinity, whose theme is suffering that opens you. UL 22, Treasure of the Way, carries grace. UL 36, Crystal Creation, carries the dark stretch that tests you. UL 37, Journey Home, carries the warmth of a family. This one carries the first question. Five of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.
fields.body:
Sleep is the reason this energy is given to the pineal gland. The gland is the part of you that says the day is finished. About two hours before your usual bedtime it begins to tell your body that night has come. It says only that it is night, and leaves the sleeping to you. On some evenings your head lets go when it hears this, and on others the questions go on.

It keeps a clock that runs a little longer than a day. Each morning the first light through your eyes sets it again. Kept in dim light, a person drifts later day by day, and a morning outdoors puts it right. The doubt in you has a chemistry, and one substance in it is proline. Every protein in you is built from twenty pieces, and this is the one that turns the chain wherever it sits. When fear takes hold of doubt, heavy hormones go through you. Self-doubt taken all the way drains the body at that level, until your strength is simply gone.

Every person carries the same discomfort of not remembering who they truly are, and all people are equal in this one suffering. You share its chemistry with three other energies.

fields.essence: Imagination wakes in you in the middle of a change, when the old order has gone and the new one has not yet formed. You see the shape and colour of a new thing before it exists. The picture wants your hands to build it. Even pain can turn into something you make, a song or a painting.
fields.glance:
Imagination wakes in you in the middle of a change, when the old order has gone and the new one has not yet formed. You see the shape and colour of a new thing before it exists. The picture wants your hands to build it. Even pain can turn into something you make, a song or a painting.

Not knowing can feel hard to bear while everything is in pieces, and you want order back. Near the end, keep your eyes on the work in front of you, because the picture can make a thing feel done before it is.

Trust the pictures that come, even the strange ones, and start building. It is like riding a wild horse: you can steer it only where it agrees to go. Your life becomes a work of art, always in progress.
fields.iching:
You are nearly across, and the last stretch is the one that decides it. Most of what you set out to do is done. The far bank is so close that watching your step now feels foolish. This is the moment the fox wets its tail. It acts as if it were across before it is, and loses the whole crossing at the last step.

What this time asks is that you check what is done before you call it done. Look at each part of what you have made and ask what it is really doing. Fire can warm water or boil it away, and water can cool a fire or put it out. The same two things help or harm depending on where they sit. So put each thing where it does its good.

Your feet are the last of you to cross, so keep your attention on them until you are out. Take the last step as carefully as the first. Wanting to be across is not the same as being across. Fire over Water is the hexagram of being nearly across. Fire is the clearness in you that tells one thing from another. Water is the risk you are still standing in. The clearness sits above the risk because you can see where you are going long before you are out of danger. That is why this hexagram has long been read as a young fox crossing a river. A step from the bank it thinks it is across, its tail goes in the water, and it cannot go on. Fire climbs and water sinks, so the two draw apart until each is set in its place. You can see clearly and still be in danger. Before Completion
fields.gene_keys:
Confusion Imagination Illumination Imagination begins when you stop trying to make the not knowing go away. The mind that was busy explaining goes quiet. The energy it was using comes back to you, and you start to make things with it. What arrives first is often the ache you were trying to avoid. Give it a shape in paint, in words or in a song, and it begins to change in your hands. Keep going, and the fears you drew at the start turn out to hold something good.

Imagination is also the end of copying. It goes where nobody has been, too quick and too wild to stop and explain itself. It will not keep to what you did last year. It asks you to let your life keep changing. Confusion is what a mind feels when everything in it has come loose and nothing has its order yet. It comes when what you knew about yourself stops holding. In itself it is full of what could be. It turns painful only when the mind tries to explain it. The mind wants a reason, then something to do, then the old order back.

Being unfinished is hard to bear, so the pull is to keep things as they were. A change that was trying to move you gets pressed back into its old shape. While it lasts you feel alone in it. Illumination is imagination that no longer belongs to you. The pictures and words still come, and they are made for whoever needs them. You stay empty while they pour through you.

Near such a person the eyes seem to shine and the room seems to shimmer. You hear such people only once you stop listening for the meaning. In the quiet between their words something true gets across.
fields.human_design: Confusion Gate 64 sits at the top of your head, where the question how begins. It fills with pictures: images, dreams and pieces of the past that arrive out of order. You can see them long before you can explain them. Along a straight line they read as a mess, which is why the gate is named for confusion. The pressure is to answer at once how each picture becomes real. Answered too early, that question shuts the dreaming down and leaves you tired and low.
fields.tarot: This energy turns a loose state into something new, and it does not do it alone. It belongs to a family of four called the Ring of Alchemy. UL 6 breaks down the walls between people, UL 40 builds that openness into communities, and UL 47 lets old ways change. This one opens a fresh set of possibilities. Four of the tarot's major cards, its Arcana, arrive through the ring and the two trigrams.
fields.body:
The pineal gland carries this energy, and the reason is light. It is the size of a grain of rice and sits in the middle of your head, where no daylight ever reaches. It learns whether the sun is up from your eyes, by a long road down into the neck and back. When the eyes report that the light has gone, it lets out the hormone of the dark and your body begins to slow. So a gland that lives in the dark keeps your day by light.

Sit in a dim room in the evening and within an hour or two you feel yourself grow heavy. Switch on a bright screen and the gland reads it as day, and the heaviness holds off. The light that lies hidden in you until it is ready to show has a substance, and it is glycine. It is the smallest of the twenty pieces your proteins are built from. Your body makes its own and takes in more from meat, fish and the jelly a cooled stock sets into. In your brain it sits at the gate where memory is laid down, and that gate will not open until glycine is in its seat.

You share this substance with three kin, and together the four change one state into the next. That change has long been told in colours. It starts black and passes through white and yellow to the red of gold. So whatever feels dark in you now is where that change begins.
